stories.title: Indian Police Surround Protest Site in Delhi Over Voter Lists
stories.summary:
Indian security personnel, equipped with batons, shields, and riot control vehicles, surrounded a planned opposition protest site in New Delhi on Sunday. Led by Congress party leader Rahul Gandhi, the demonstration demands the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over a contentious voter list revision. Organizers expect hundreds of thousands of participants to join the march from Central Delhi to the Ramlila Maidan, posing a significant challenge to Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).

The protests follow a September report by The Indian Express, which revealed that Kumar's two deputies raised internal concerns about digital systems, registration procedures, and voter list changes. Initiated last year, the revision removed more than 130 million names—including 28 million deceased individuals, 63 million relocated voters, and 30 million untraced persons. Opposition parties and youth groups claim these deletions disproportionately impact Muslims and other minorities unlikely to support the Hindu nationalist government. The Election Commission and the BJP have firmly denied these allegations, maintaining that wrongly deleted voters can re-enrol and accusing critics of undermining legitimate electoral processes.

Authorities implemented traffic regulations and diversions across the capital as crowds began gathering for the rally. Senior police official Rohit Rajbir stated that proper security arrangements were established both at the venue and along the march route to ensure smooth movement. Analysts note that these demonstrations represent the most severe crisis for Modi since taking office in 2014, although his government remains politically stable with the next general election scheduled for 2029.

stories.title: Binance Resumes Withdrawals After Recovering Most of Stolen Funds
stories.summary:
Cryptocurrency exchange Binance announced it would resume withdrawals on Sunday after successfully covering 95 percent of the $6.3 billion in digital tokens stolen from its platform. The breach represents the largest digital heist in history, with the FBI attributing the attack to the North Korean state-sponsored cyber unit known as TraderTraitor. To offset the loss, Binance utilized company funds to purchase replacement tokens, drawing from its Secure Asset Fund for Users (Safu), its Futures Insurance Fund, and corporate treasury reserves. Co-CEO Yi He confirmed that 50 percent of the Safu reserve was utilized, with a commitment to replenish the fund to approximately $1 billion.

The initial phase of withdrawals, scheduled between 0600 and 0900 GMT, covers 15 major crypto assets, including bitcoin, ether, XRP, and dogecoin. The remaining five percent of stolen assets consist of less liquid tokens that require more time to source in the necessary quantities. The attack unfolded rapidly late Thursday and bore strong technical similarities to previous major heists blamed on North Korea, according to blockchain analysis firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis. Law enforcement observed hackers converting stolen funds into ether, anticipating further laundering efforts.

While international investigators and blockchain firms pointed toward Pyongyang, US President Donald Trump stated on Saturday that the United States was not yet certain of North Korean involvement. Binance, which serves 335 million registered users globally and held roughly $162.8 billion in assets under custody in its 2025 annual report, has been collaborating with industry partners to freeze affected assets, successfully locating about $3 billion by Friday. Co-CEO Richard Teng described the incident as a complex operation involving a compromised laptop and malicious software designed to erase activity logs.

stories.title: روس کے نئے فِلِن کروز میزائل کی خصوصیات اور یوکرین کو خطرات
stories.summary:
روس موسم گرما 2026 کے اختتام سے یوکرین پر حملوں کے لیے فِلِن نامی کروز میزائل استعمال کر رہا ہے۔ یہ ہتھیار سستا، چھوٹا اور ٹربو جیٹ انجن پر مشتمل ہے، جسے ایک بوسٹر کی مدد سے زمینی لانچر سے داغا جاتا ہے۔ ماسکو میں قائم مولنیا سائنٹیفک پروڈکشن ایسوسی ایشن نے اسے تیار کیا ہے، اور اس میں آر-500 گیس ٹربائن انجن استعمال ہوتا ہے۔

اس میزائل کی زیادہ سے زیادہ رفتار 800 کلومیٹر فی گھنٹہ اور مار کی حد 1,200 کلومیٹر تک بتائی جاتی ہے۔ یہ کم بلندی سے لے کر 6 کلومیٹر تک پرواز کر سکتا ہے اور اس کے وارہیڈ کا وزن 50 سے 100 کلوگرام تک ہے۔ یوکرینی انٹیلی جنس کے مطابق، اس کے الیکٹرانک نظام میں غیر ملکی پرزے بھی شامل ہیں۔

فِلِن میزائل کم بلندی پر پرواز کرنے کی صلاحیت رکھتا ہے، جس کی وجہ سے اسے انٹرسیپٹر ڈرونز یا روایتی توپوں سے نشانہ بنانا مشکل ہوتا ہے۔ ماہرین کا کہنا ہے کہ اگر روس اسے بڑے پیمانے پر تیار کرنے میں کامیاب ہو گیا تو یہ یوکرین کے فضائی دفاعی نظام پر نمایاں اضافی دباؤ ڈالے گا۔

یوکرین کو خدشہ ہے کہ فِلِن کی بڑی تعداد میں دستیابی سے اس کے دفاعی وسائل تقسیم ہو سکتے ہیں۔ تاہم، اس کی اصل لاگت اور پیداواری حجم کے حوالے سے اب بھی غیر یقینی صورتحال پائی جاتی ہے، اور اس کا اثر فضائی جنگ کی مجموعی صورتحال پر کیا ہوگا، یہ مستقبل میں واضح ہوگا۔

stories.title: AI Chatbots Spread Election Misinformation Ahead of US Midterms
stories.summary:
Researchers warn that artificial intelligence chatbots are spreading misleading voter information, misidentifying candidates, and repeating foreign propaganda ahead of the November 3 US midterm elections. Marking the first federal election where millions of voters rely heavily on AI for political insights, studies show that open-web models frequently pull from unreliable sources, eroding public trust. A recent evaluation by start-up Forum AI found that nearly 40 percent of chatbot responses regarding the election contained factual errors, with models struggling more with voting logistics than candidate information.

Examples of errors cited in studies include Google’s Gemini 3.6 Flash providing an incorrect mail-in ballot deadline for Pennsylvania and Anthropic’s Claude misidentifying North Carolina Representative Don Davis as a former school superintendent. Furthermore, a study by disinformation watchdog NewsGuard revealed that tools from Google and Microsoft repeated an unfounded, AI-altered allegation regarding Texas Senate candidate James Talarico that bore hallmarks of a Russian influence operation. While Google and Microsoft noted that their systems rapidly updated to reflect reliable reporting and context, researchers emphasized that users remain vulnerable to foreign actors and fabricated claims.

Despite these vulnerabilities, research from the Brennan Center for Justice indicated that leading chatbots successfully pushed back against common conspiracy theories, such as rigged voting machines, even when repeatedly challenged by users. A survey by the nonpartisan National Conference on Citizenship showed that two in five Americans used AI for election information, though only 40 percent trusted the tools with logistical details like voting locations and deadlines, and 60 percent expressed deep skepticism regarding political bias.

stories.title: Trump Says US is Examining Report on Nvidia CEO and China
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump stated on Saturday that his administration is closely reviewing intelligence regarding a report that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was the target of a Chinese espionage plot. Speaking at his Florida residence, Trump praised Huang as a "brilliant" leader and emphasized the importance of protecting key technology figures, noting that he would check into the situation carefully. The New York Times reported on Thursday that US intelligence officials concluded a Chinese executive linked to a Singapore-based data center firm had been funneling information to Beijing after interacting with Huang. China has dismissed the intelligence report as groundless speculation.

When asked if he would maintain Huang as an advisory figure, Trump indicated he viewed the Nvidia chief as very trustworthy, provided no contradicting evidence emerges from the investigation. Huang has previously advised the White House on artificial intelligence policy and joined other technology executives during Trump’s visit to Beijing in May to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping. The Taiwan-born businessman has consistently advocated for supplying his company's advanced semiconductors to the Chinese market, even as Beijing accelerates its own domestic chip development efforts amidst escalating technological competition between the two global powers.

stories.title: South Africa Defeats Australia to Claim Test Series Victory
stories.summary:
South Africa secured a 176-run victory over Australia at Newlands on Saturday, claiming the three-Test series 2-1 and moving to the top of the Test world rankings for the first time since January 2016. Spin bowler Simon Harmer delivered a career-best performance with figures of 6-16 in the innings, finishing with a match total of 10-120. Meanwhile, fast bowler Kagiso Rabada took 3-39 in the innings to reach 350 career Test wickets.

Rabada reached the 350-wicket milestone by bowling 13,808 deliveries, making him the fastest bowler to achieve the feat by balls bowled. He surpassed compatriot Dale Steyn, who took 14,719 deliveries, and Pakistan's Waqar Younis, who required 14,905. Harmer played a crucial role on the turning pitch by dismantling Australia's batting order, which included ending a defensive 90-ball innings of 11 runs by Australia captain Pat Cummins.

Chasing a target of 288 runs for victory, the visiting Australian team collapsed and was bowled out for just 111 runs. The heavy defeat caused Australia to surrender their top position in the Test world rankings to South Africa. The loss raises significant questions for the Australian side following consecutive heavy defeats in the concluding matches of the series.

This crucial win marks a major milestone for South Africa's Test cricket team, propelled by historic bowling achievements. The triumph at Newlands cements their resurgence at the pinnacle of international red-ball cricket, while leaving Australia to reevaluate their squad and strategy moving forward.

stories.title: Australia Captain Cummins Faces Questions Following Series Defeat
stories.summary:
Australia captain Pat Cummins acknowledged that internal and external scrutiny is fair after his team suffered two consecutive heavy losses to lose their three-match Test series 2-1 against South Africa at Newlands on Saturday. Chasing a 288-run target for victory in the third Test, Australia were dismissed for 111 runs, following an innings and 31-run defeat in the second match.

The series loss cost Australia their top spot in the Test world rankings, with South Africa claiming the number one position. Cummins stated that the team needs to improve if they want to reclaim the top ranking, suggesting potential changes in team personnel or playing style. He noted that the squad will review their performances internally ahead of their upcoming series hosting New Zealand.

Reflecting on the match, Cummins defended his controversial decision to bowl first after winning the toss on the opening morning, an unusual tactic previously used only 11 times in Tests at Newlands since 1889. He explained that the team anticipated taking ten wickets on day one on a wearing surface, but acknowledged that batting last became extremely difficult due to the spinning conditions exploited by South Africa's Simon Harmer, who claimed match figures of 10-120.

Cummins also criticized his batters for making poor decisions during the chase, stating that the run-chase was effectively derailed within the first half-hour of the final day. Despite the challenging day-five wicket, he believed runs were available and that the team failed to give themselves a proper chance to succeed.

stories.title: Alcaraz and De Minaur Advance to Vienna Open Final
stories.summary:
Carlos Alcaraz defeated Daniil Medvedev 6-4, 7-6(2) on Saturday to reach the Vienna Open final for the first time in his career. The Spanish second seed extended his ATP 500 winning streak to 25 matches and secured his 37th tour-level final appearance, as well as his fifth final of the current year. Alcaraz captured the opening set after Medvedev double-faulted on set point, but the Russian fought back in the second set to force a tiebreak. Alcaraz ultimately dominated the tiebreak with powerful groundstrokes to seal the victory in 96 minutes.

The win provided Alcaraz with a measure of revenge against Medvedev, who handed him his first loss of the season during the Indian Wells semi-finals in March, while also ending Medvedev's seven-match winning streak. Both players have already secured qualification for the upcoming ATP Finals next month.

In the other semi-final, Australian Alex de Minaur achieved one of the biggest victories of his career by upsetting world number one-elect Alexander Zverev 6-4, 1-6, 7-6(4). De Minaur advanced to his 23rd tour-level final and his first in Vienna, improving his indoor record this season to a flawless 10-0. The win kept his hopes alive of qualifying for the ATP Finals and denied Zverev a spot in the final just days after it was confirmed the German would claim the top spot in the world rankings on Monday.

Alcaraz and De Minaur are now scheduled to meet in the championship match on Sunday. The clash features two in-form competitors looking to cap off strong indoor campaigns with a prestigious tournament title.

stories.title: International Officials Discuss Limited Black Sea Ceasefire Proposals
stories.summary:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated on Saturday that the international community is showing growing interest in establishing a limited ceasefire in the Black Sea to protect grain and energy shipments from Russia and Ukraine. Speaking at a press conference in Atlanta following a two-day meeting of G20 foreign ministers, Rubio noted that the United States is reviewing proposals from Turkiye and India aimed at keeping grain vessels moving. While partial agreements could address food and energy security, the US continues to pursue a broader negotiated settlement to the ongoing war, now in its fifth year.

The G20 gathering of major economies took place without producing a joint statement or consensus, driven largely by sharp divisions over conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East. The inclusion of Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov sparked objections from European and Canadian leaders who argued his presence normalized aggression. Rubio defended the invitation, asserting that diplomatic resolution is impossible without communicating with Moscow, though he admitted a comprehensive peace deal is not imminent. Rubio also mentioned a brief sideline conversation with Lavrov regarding potential meetings between US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand stated during an interview that she directly confronted Lavrov in a closed-door session regarding Russia's invasion, the targeting of Ukrainian ships, and other violations of international law. Anand revealed she has held active discussions with Ukrainian officials, including Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha, as well as Indian counterparts to advance a Black Sea ceasefire and a moratorium on attacks against electrical infrastructure ahead of the approaching winter. Countries like India and Egypt have expressed strong concerns over the safety of their merchant ships and sailors.

Meanwhile, Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov reiterated that Moscow's position remains unchanged, stating Russia cannot accept Ukraine as a security threat. Rubio emphasized that global cooperation remains essential for addressing shared geopolitical and economic challenges, leaving open the possibility for future diplomatic engagement involving leaders from the United States, Russia, and Ukraine.

stories.title: US President Trump Says One or Two Iranian Targets Remain
stories.summary:
United States President Donald Trump stated on Saturday that although the US has severely damaged Iran’s military, there are still one or two targets that need to be addressed. Speaking at his Florida residence, Trump specifically pointed to a suspected underground nuclear complex known as Pickaxe Mountain. He remarked that addressing this remaining site could be accomplished very quickly, noting that the ongoing negotiations to end the war initiated by the US and Israel at the end of February were progressing despite reliability concerns.

Trump reaffirmed that the US is not rushing into additional offensive actions because the Iranian military and nuclear program have already been heavily diminished. Earlier on Saturday, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio mentioned that no final decision has been made regarding new strikes and that Washington remains open to diplomatic resolutions. Conversely, Iran’s supreme leader issued a warning on Saturday against any new military attacks following recent threats to resume hostilities after elections.

President Trump previously warned about the possibility of fresh military action following US midterms, questioning whether to completely finish off the adversary. The Iranian government has consistently denied that any nuclear activities take place at the Pickaxe Mountain location. The ongoing conflict stems from military operations launched by the United States and Israel at the close of February.

Understanding these developments is vital for assessing the fragile diplomatic and military landscape in the Middle East. While Washington signals openness to negotiations, the explicit threat of swift renewed strikes on sites like Pickaxe Mountain keeps regional tensions exceptionally high. The situation highlights the precarious balance between military posturing and potential diplomatic pathways as political leaders navigate domestic and international pressures.

stories.title: Malaysia Airlines Reports Customer Data Risk from Amadeus Breach
stories.summary:
Malaysia Airlines announced on Sunday that a cybersecurity incident involving its reservation-technology provider, Amadeus, may have compromised certain customer information. The flag carrier indicated that the affected data pertains to information processed between August 2023 and September of this current year. The airline is actively collaborating with Amadeus and other relevant stakeholders to investigate the breach and evaluate its overall impact on passengers.

According to the airline, its internal IT systems experienced no direct breach, and there is currently no evidence indicating that financial information was accessed. Nevertheless, passengers have been strongly advised to remain cautious regarding any suspicious or unsolicited communications, especially those asking for personal or financial details. Malaysia Airlines joins a growing list of international carriers, including Cathay Pacific Airways, Japan Airlines, and South Korea’s Asiana Airlines, that have reported similar compromises linked to the Amadeus vulnerability.

Amadeus acknowledged a security vulnerability affecting a travel booking display environment, though it has not disclosed the exact number of customers impacted by the issue. Recent disclosures by other airlines reveal significant reach, with Cathay Pacific and Japan Airlines reporting affected data across 53,000 bookings and 92,000 customers, respectively. The incident underscores growing concerns regarding cybersecurity vulnerabilities within centralized third-party reservation systems used by the global aviation industry.

This event matters because it highlights systemic cybersecurity risks inherent in third-party vendor integrations within the global travel sector. As major airlines increasingly rely on shared reservation platforms like Amadeus, a single security flaw can trigger widespread data exposures across multiple international carriers. Protecting passenger trust requires heightened vigilance and robust cooperation between airlines and technology providers to secure sensitive personal information.

stories.title: German Gas Storage Levels Fall to Record Lows Before Winter
stories.summary:
Germany's gas storage industry association, INES, warned on Sunday that the nation must urgently review and enhance its gas cavern filling mechanisms. With winter approaching, Germany's gas storage levels remained at record lows, standing at 61.35 percent as of October 30. This figure falls significantly short of the 80 percent target that Germany had established for November 1, sparking renewed concerns over potential supply shortages despite government assurances that bottlenecks will be avoided.

INES Managing Director Sebastian Heinermann emphasized that missing the storage targets demonstrates a clear need to guarantee winter reserves much more rigorously through stricter measures. The primary factor behind the depleted storage levels has been the ongoing war in Iran, which drove up energy prices and rendered the filling of caverns during the summer uneconomically viable. Heinermann expressed support for the Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs being open to imposing storage obligations on suppliers, urging that specific options be discussed and legislated without delay.

To aid the political process, INES prepared a comprehensive report in collaboration with the gas grid operator association FNB Gas. Meanwhile, the German government recently rejected accusations from Italy claiming that Germany deliberately neglected to fill its gas reserves to lower costs for import companies ahead of their privatization. These developments coincide with projections that Germany is heading toward a record trade deficit with the Asia-Pacific region in 2026.

This situation is critical for Europe's top economy as it faces heating demands during the colder months amid volatile geopolitical energy markets. Failing to maintain adequate gas reserves exposes the country to severe supply risks and price volatility stemming from international conflicts. Implementing mandatory storage obligations for suppliers could reshape Germany's regulatory framework to secure long-term energy stability.

stories.title: Trump Calls Former Lawyer Alina Habba Mildon's DOJ Contract 'Unacceptable'
stories.summary:
President Donald Trump publicly criticized his former lawyer, Alina Habba Mildon, describing a lucrative financial contract she secured while working at the United States Department of Justice as completely unacceptable and outrageous. The remarks followed a report by The New York Times revealing that the family of Julio Herrera Velutini, a Venezuelan banker facing federal felony bribery charges, had guaranteed Habba Mildon a payment package exceeding $50 million over four years, which included an annual salary of $10 million plus bonuses.

At the time the contract was signed in late October 2025 with Concord Partners, a company belonging to the Herrera family, Habba Mildon was serving as the acting US attorney in New Jersey. According to the report, a court had already disqualified her from holding the US attorney position by the time she officially began her employment with the Herrera family. She subsequently resigned from her post on December 8, 2025, and was appointed as a senior adviser to the attorney general on the exact same day, holding that position when she reportedly started at Concord on January 1, 2026.

President Trump stated that he informed Habba Mildon he did not want her to accept the payments and labeled the entire situation terrible. Court records from the Justice Department website indicate that Trump later granted a pardon to Herrera on January 15, 2026. In response to the growing scrutiny, Habba Mildon stated the previous week that she never received any payment for a pardon, never held discussions with anyone at the White House or the Justice Department regarding a pardon, and never performed any work to secure a pardon for any individual. The Justice Department did not provide an immediate response to requests for comment regarding the matter.

stories.title: Consumer Goods Firms in Pakistan Report Strong Sales Despite Inflation
stories.summary:
A collection of local and multinational consumer goods companies operating in Pakistan announced improved sales figures for the first nine months of 2026 and the initial quarter of the 2027 fiscal year. This financial resilience occurred despite challenging economic conditions characterized by rising food inflation, regional conflicts, and decreased household purchasing power driven by higher fuel and energy costs. These elevated expenses stem from Middle East tensions that escalated following the onset of the US-Israel war on Iran on February 28.

Nestlé Pakistan reported net sales totaling Rs160 billion for the nine-month period ending September 30, reflecting a 6.3 percent increase compared to the previous year, while net profit after tax rose 3.1 percent to Rs14.526 billion. The company credited brand investments, product innovation, and disciplined pricing for the results, though it maintained a cautious outlook for the remainder of 2026 due to geopolitical instability. Similarly, FrieslandCampina Engro Pakistan saw revenues climb 10.1 percent to Rs88.4 billion and profits increase to Rs6.5 billion, even as regional conflicts and energy prices squeezed its operational margins and consumer affordability.

Other major market players experienced comparable growth trends during the period. Unilever Pakistan Foods recorded sales of Rs37.6 billion and a profit after tax of Rs6.326 billion, supported by resilient macroeconomic fundamentals. Colgate-Palmolive Pakistan achieved a 25.53 percent jump in sales to Rs52.7 billion between July and September 2026, alongside an 8 percent profit increase, though it continued to face supply chain risks due to its reliance on Gulf Cooperation Council countries for raw materials. Fauji Foods Limited reached a record nine-month revenue of Rs23.9 billion, while National Foods Limited posted sales of Rs11.1 billion with an anticipated 15 percent revenue growth for the 2027 fiscal year, despite facing skyrocketing container freight rates that surged as high as $5,000.

stories.title: پنچکولا کے اسکول میں بچے کے تشدد پر انتظامیہ کے خلاف مقدمہ
stories.summary:
بھارت کے شہر پنچکولا کے ایک اسکول میں 28 اکتوبر 2026 کو ایک حیرت انگیز اور دل دہلا دینے والا واقعہ پیش آیا جہاں تیسری جماعت کے آٹھ سالہ طالب علم نے چھ سالہ بچی پر شدید تشدد کیا۔ اس حملے میں معصوم بچی شدید زخمی ہو گئی جسے پہلے مقامی اسپتال اور بعد میں چندی گڑھ کے پی جی آئی منتقل کیا گیا، جہاں وہ خطرے سے باہر بتائی جاتی ہے۔

بچی کے والد کے مطابق اسکول کی چھٹی کے بعد جب بچی نہیں ملی تو تلاش پر وہ ایک تالا بند کمرے میں ملی۔ واقعہ کی سی سی ٹی وی فوٹیج سوشل میڈیا پر وائرل ہونے کے بعد صارفین کی جانب سے شدید تشویش کا اظہار کیا جا رہا ہے، جبکہ کچھ لوگ اس کی وجہ بچوں پر تعلیمی دباؤ اور غیر صحت مند گھریلو ماحول کو قرار دے رہے ہیں۔

پولیس نے اس معاملے میں جووینائل جسٹس ایکٹ اور بی این ایس کی دفعات کے تحت اسکول کے پرنسپل، کلاس انچارج اور چوکیدار کے خلاف ایف آئی آر درج کر لی ہے۔ ڈپٹی کمشنر آف پولیس ادیتی سنگھ اور کرائم ڈی سی پی امرندر سنگھ کے مطابق، آٹھ سالہ بچے کو قانوناً سزا یا جیل نہیں بھیجا جا سکتا اس لیے اس کی کونسلنگ اور اصلاح پر توجہ دی جا رہی ہے اور اسے آبزرویشن ہوم بھجوا دیا گیا ہے۔

ہریانہ حکومت نے اس سنگین واقعے کی جانچ کے لیے ایک اعلیٰ سطحی تحقیقاتی کمیٹی تشکیل دے دی ہے جبکہ وزیرِ تعلیم مہی پال ڈھانڈا نے غفلت برتنے والوں کے خلاف سخت کارروائی کا انتباہ دیا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ ریاستی کمیشن برائے تحفظِ حقوقِ اطفال اور ہیومن رائٹس کمیشن نے بھی واقعے کا نوٹس لیتے ہوئے ضلعی حکام سے تفصیلی رپورٹس طلب کر لی ہیں۔

stories.title: خیبرپختونخوا کے 12 اضلاع کیلئے پولیس کو 30 سے 40 ارب روپے درکار
stories.summary:
آئی جی خیبرپختونخوا ذوالفقار حمید کا کہنا ہے کہ صوبے کے 12 اضلاع کے لیے پولیس کو 30 سے 40 ارب روپے کی ضرورت ہے۔ اس فنڈ کے حصول کے لیے وفاقی حکومت کے ساتھ بات چیت جاری ہے، اور ان اضلاع میں چار اہم کیٹگریز پر توجہ مرکوز کی جا رہی ہے۔

مذکورہ اضلاع میں جدید اسلحہ، ڈرون اور دیگر ساز و سامان کی فراہمی بنیادی ترجیح ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ، ایک سال کے اندر تمام متعلقہ اضلاع میں سیف سٹی پراجیکٹس مکمل کرنے کا ارادہ ہے تاکہ سیکورٹی کے بنیادی ڈھانچے کو بہتر بنایا جا سکے۔

آئی جی پولیس نے بتایا کہ ضم شدہ اضلاع میں پہلے سے پولیس کا کوئی مضبوط انفرااسٹرکچر موجود نہیں تھا، اس لیے وہاں نئی عمارتیں تعمیر کی جا رہی ہیں۔ کمزور تنظیمی ڈھانچے کو تقویت دینے کے ساتھ ساتھ پولیس کی نفری کی کمی کو پورا کر کے خصوصی تربیت بھی دی جائے گی۔

اس کے علاوہ، خیبرپختونخوا پولیس کے ملازمین کی تنخواہوں میں اضافے سے متعلق ایک سمری بھی تیار کی گئی ہے۔ اس تجویز کو محکمہ خزانہ کی رائے کے بعد گورنر کو ارسال کیا جائے گا تاکہ پولیس اہلکاروں کے مالی معاملات بہتر ہو سکیں۔

stories.title: Binance to Resume Withdrawals After Recovering Most of Stolen Funds
stories.summary:
Cryptocurrency exchange Binance announced plans to roll out phased withdrawals after successfully recovering 95 percent of the $6.3 billion in digital tokens stolen from its network during what is considered the largest digital heist in history. The platform stated that the initial phase of resuming withdrawals would take place between 0600 and 0900 GMT on Sunday, encompassing major cryptocurrencies such as bitcoin, ether, BNB, Solana, XRP, and dogecoin, among other digital assets.

The massive security breach, which occurred recently, was officially attributed by the FBI to a North Korean state-sponsored cyber unit known as TraderTraitor. According to the FBI, law enforcement officials observed members of this specific unit converting portions of the stolen cryptocurrency holdings into ethereum, and law enforcement agencies anticipate that the threat actors will attempt further laundering activities using related technological methods.

Binance clarified that the remaining 5 percent of the stolen funds consists of assets that feature lower liquidity levels, meaning it will require additional time to source those specific amounts correctly. Meanwhile, the government of North Korea has historically denied utilizing state-affiliated cyber units for financial theft, espionage, or revenue generation. Official representatives at the North Korean mission in Geneva and its embassy in China did not provide responses to media inquiries seeking comment on the incident.

stories.title: Indian Security Tightened in Delhi Ahead of Major Opposition Protest Rally
stories.summary:
Indian authorities deployed heavy security measures, including baton-wielding personnel, protective shields, and riot control vehicles, around the designated protest site in New Delhi ahead of a major opposition demonstration. The rally, spearheaded by prominent Congress party leader Rahul Gandhi, aims to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Organizers anticipated participation from hundreds of thousands of citizens in what is framed as a significant challenge to Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party.

The daily demonstrations calling for Kumar's departure began following an investigative report published by The Indian Express in September, which revealed that two deputy election commissioners had internally raised serious concerns regarding voter list revisions, registration procedures, and digital infrastructure. The nationwide voter list revision process ultimately removed over 130 million names, which includes 28 million deceased individuals, 63 million relocated citizens, and 30 million people who could not be located. Opposition parties and minority groups have argued that these deletions disproportionately impact Muslim voters and other minority populations who typically oppose the Hindu nationalist administration.

Both the Election Commission and the BJP have firmly denied allegations of political bias or attempts to undermine democratic processes, maintaining that voters whose names were incorrectly deleted retain the opportunity to re-enrol. Analysts have described the ongoing youth-led protests and mounting opposition momentum as the most severe political crisis facing Modi's government since it assumed power in 2014. Despite the widespread unrest, the government retains stability, and the next scheduled general election remains set for 2029. Police officials implemented extensive traffic regulations and diversions across Central Delhi as demonstrators gathered near the Ramlila Maidan rally venue.

stories.title: Binance Covers $6 Billion of Funds Stolen in Major Hack
stories.summary:
Binance has successfully covered $6 billion of the $6.3 billion stolen during a recent security breach on its platform. The world's largest cryptocurrency exchange utilized corporate funds, its Futures Insurance Fund, and part of its Secure Asset Fund for Users to acquire replacement tokens. US officials attribute the cyberattack to TraderTraitor, a North Korean state-sponsored unit.

The remaining uncovered loss amounts to less than 10 percent of the total, consisting of less liquid assets that require more time to procure. To fund the replacements, co-CEO Yi He stated that half of the user protection reserve fund would be utilized, with the company fully committed to restoring the reserve back to approximately $1 billion. Law enforcement observed members of the North Korean unit converting stolen funds into ethereum, prompting further investigation into asset laundering.

The security breach was described as a complex operation involving a compromised laptop and malicious software designed to erase activity logs. In response to the incident, the platform temporarily halted customer withdrawals while assuring users that their funds remained secure, and it expected to resume withdrawal services shortly.

As part of its proof-of-reserves protocol, Binance captured a new asset snapshot covering ten major listed tokens. The exchange aims to allow users to verify a minimum one-to-one backing for their holdings once the complete proof-of-reserves data becomes fully available.

stories.title: Frankfurt Stores Looted as Gen Z Protests Turn Violent in Germany
stories.summary:
Hooded rioters engaged in looting across Frankfurt late on Saturday as tens of thousands of demonstrators took to the streets in multiple German cities. Organized by the campaign group 'Gen Z regelt,' the protests spanned 34 cities to oppose compulsory military service, advocate for lower living costs, and demand increased investment in education and healthcare.

The demonstrations turned violent in Frankfurt, Germany's financial hub, where at least two stores were looted and several others suffered property damage. Police reported that windows were smashed at multiple shops and Molotov cocktails were thrown at emergency services. Similar unrest was observed in Hamburg, where barricades were set on fire by participants.

While organizers initially anticipated an attendance of 182,000, official estimates indicated a much lower turnout of around 18,000 to 36,000 protesters across Berlin, Munich, and Frankfurt. German authorities noted that the demonstrations largely coincided with Halloween celebrations and warned that extremist groups were attempting to exploit the youth-led movement.

Government officials and regional leaders expressed concern over the escalation, drawing comparisons to recent rioting and civil unrest in France. Despite the violence, organizers emphasized their intention to continue exercising their constitutional right to assembly until the government addresses economic pressures on younger generations.

stories.title: World Bank Approves $150 Million to Enhance Karachi Property Tax
stories.summary:
The World Bank has endorsed a $150 million financing initiative aimed at improving urban immovable property tax collection and municipal service delivery across 25 towns in Karachi. The Sindh Property Revenues Enhancement Programme was cleared by the World Bank board of executive directors to benefit local councils within the region.

The primary beneficiaries include approximately 3.58 million residents living within the participating local councils. Currently, local councils in Sindh rely heavily on provincial transfers for more than 95 percent of their total revenues, limiting their financial autonomy for long-term urban planning and development.

Under the new programme, roughly 70 percent of the property tax revenues collected will be directly reinvested into local municipal infrastructure and services. World Bank officials noted that Karachi possesses significant untapped revenue potential from its extensive property base, which can be harnessed to fund essential public infrastructure.

By strengthening fiscal sustainability and improving local revenue collection, the initiative seeks to empower Sindh's cities to independently plan, invest, and deliver public services effectively from their own financial resources.

stories.title: South Korea October Exports Nearly Double on Global AI Demand
stories.summary:
South Korea experienced a historic surge in exports in October, nearly doubling compared to the previous year in the sharpest jump recorded in over fifty years. Total exports reached $115.28 billion, marking a 93.7 percent increase driven primarily by robust international demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure and semiconductor investments.

The export growth exceeded economists' median forecasts and surpassed September's 83.7 percent gain, aided by additional working days compared to the previous year. Semiconductor shipments soared by 259.4 percent to $56.44 billion, while computer sales climbed 496.6 percent due to rising server demand for AI services. Major trade partners saw substantial increases, with shipments to China jumping 133.6 percent and exports to the United States growing by 185.8 percent.

Strong performance in chip manufacturing has driven South Korea's economic growth above expectations for the third quarter, bolstered by high profits at major corporations like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. Trade Minister Kim Jung-kwan noted that annual exports are on track to surpass the $1-billion milestone before the end of November, placing South Korea alongside the United States, China, and Germany in achieving the threshold.

Meanwhile, South Korea's imports grew by 36.0 percent to $72.78 billion, propelled by higher crude oil prices and increased demand for automobiles and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Consequently, the nation posted a monthly trade surplus of $42.50 billion for October.

stories.title: Bangladesh Government to Establish Wage Board Following Garment Worker Protests
stories.summary:
The government of Bangladesh plans to establish a wage board to evaluate compensation for garment workers following widespread demonstrations and factory closures that have impacted the nation's critical export sector. Employees in the South Asian country have requested a minimum monthly salary of 30,000 taka, equivalent to $245, which exceeds their current 12,500 taka wage. Protesters argue that escalating expenses for food, housing, transport, and healthcare have severely diminished their financial purchasing power.

This labor dispute threatens an industry supporting approximately 4 million workers, accounting for over 80% of total export revenue, and providing apparel to numerous prominent Western brands. Labour and Employment Minister Ariful Haque Chowdhury announced that the formal wage board will be created following consultations with industry stakeholders and union leaders to resolve the ongoing tension. Demonstrations led roughly 30 garment factories in Ashulia, a major manufacturing district near Dhaka, to temporarily suspend operations, according to Mohammad Mominul Islam Bhuiyan, superintendent of the Ashulia Industrial Police.

Demonstrations also caused major traffic disruptions and blocked a prominent intersection in the capital city. Confrontations between security forces and workers in Ashulia resulted in multiple injuries, prompting officers to deploy tear gas and sound grenades to clear the crowds. Minister Chowdhury urged employees to resume their duties, emphasizing that the upcoming wage review directly addresses their primary financial demands.

Furthermore, officials cautioned that extended factory shutdowns might postpone export deliveries and incoming payments from international purchasers. Bangladesh hosts the world's largest ready-made garment sector outside of China, representing roughly 10% of the gross domestic product. However, local manufacturers note that the industry continues to encounter serious obstacles, such as increasing production expenses, frequent disruptions in gas and electricity supplies, and regional energy market instability linked to Middle Eastern conflicts.

stories.title: New Zealand Skilled Migrant Resident Visa Requirements and Application Process Explained
stories.summary:
New Zealand's Skilled Migrant Category Resident Visa provides international professionals with a pathway to secure permanent residency and establish their careers in the country. Successful candidates are permitted to reside, work, and study in New Zealand indefinitely, with options to include qualified spouses, partners, and dependent children aged 24 or younger. According to Immigration New Zealand, application fees begin at NZD 6,450, though final expenses can fluctuate based on individual applicant criteria.

To qualify, applicants must be 55 years of age or younger and satisfy established health, character, and English language criteria. Candidates must also secure full-time skilled employment or possess a legitimate job offer from a certified New Zealand enterprise. Such employment typically requires a minimum of 30 hours per week on a permanent basis, a fixed-term arrangement of at least 12 months, or consecutive contracts totaling no less than six months.

Utilizing the points-based framework, candidates are required to accumulate six skilled resident points through recognized qualifications, occupational registrations, or salary levels. Additional points can be attained via relevant skilled employment history within New Zealand. The application journey commences with the submission of an Expression of Interest, which incurs no filing fee. Candidates who fulfill necessary criteria may subsequently receive an Invitation to Apply via email.

Applicants must deliver their comprehensive residence submissions within a designated timeframe alongside supporting paperwork, including valid passports, photographs, medical evaluations, police clearances, and proof of professional credentials. Approved applicants retain indefinite residential privileges and become eligible to apply for a Permanent Resident Visa after maintaining their resident status for two consecutive years.

stories.title: Pakistani Health Minister Addresses Medicine Track and Trace System
stories.summary:
Federal Health Minister Mustafa Kamal announced that over 86,000 pharmaceutical products have been registered under the Track and Trace System in Pakistan. This digital initiative allows consumers to verify medicine authenticity and check prices using a mobile phone. Kamal shared these updates during an address to the Korangi Association of Trade and Industry in Karachi on a Saturday.

During his speech, the minister highlighted that the Drug Regulatory Authority of Pakistan has been fully digitalized and made transparent. Certification procedures that previously took years are now completed within 21 days. Over the past eight months, the digital system has successfully processed more than 5,000 cases.

Kamal acknowledged that medicine pricing requires serious attention from authorities. While pharmaceutical industries are pushing for price increases, the federal cabinet is currently reviewing the matter. He noted that raising prices presents a financial burden for ordinary citizens, but keeping prices frozen risks causing severe medicine shortages.

Consequently, patients are sometimes forced to acquire essential treatments on the black market at triple the actual cost. The ongoing considerations balance the financial well-being of the public against the risk of drug unavailability for serious illnesses. The minister's remarks underscore the complex policy challenges facing the nation's healthcare administration.

stories.title: نایاب علی ستارہ امتیاز کے لیے نامزد ہونے والی پہلی ٹرانس جینڈر بن گئیں
stories.summary:
معروف انسانی حقوق کی کارکن اور ٹرانس جینڈر خاتون نایاب علی کو حکومتِ پاکستان کی جانب سے ستارہ امتیاز کے لیے نامزد کیا گیا ہے، جس کے بعد وہ اس اعزاز کے لیے نامزد ہونے والی پہلی ٹرانس جینڈر شخصیت بن گئی ہیں۔ اعزاز دینے کی باضابطہ تقریب تیئیس مارچ سنہ دو ہزار ستائیس کو منعقد ہوگی۔ اس کے علاوہ وہ سوئٹزرلینڈ کے شہر جنیوا میں منعقد ہونے والے اقوامِ متحدہ کے سی ای ایس سی آر اجلاس میں پاکستانی وفد کا بھی حصہ ہیں۔

اس چار رکنی وفد کی سربراہی وزیرِ مملکت برائے قانون بیرسٹر عقیل ملک کر رہے ہیں، جبکہ نایاب علی اس میں ٹرانس جینڈر حقوق کی کنسلٹنٹ کی حیثیت سے شامل ہیں۔ پاکستان دوسری مرتبہ کسی ٹرانس جینڈر خاتون کو سرکاری وفد میں شامل کر رہا ہے، اس سے قبل فروری دو ہزار بیس میں عائشہ مغل نے اس طرح کی نمائندگی کی تھی۔ نایاب علی نے اوکاڑہ میں خواجہ سراؤں کے حقوق کے لیے کمیونٹی سینٹر قائم کیا، دو ہزار اٹھارہ کے عام انتخابات میں حلقہ این اے 142 سے آزاد امیدوار کے طور پر حصہ لیا اور ٹرانس جینڈر پرسنز پروٹیکشن آف رائٹس ایکٹ دو ہزار اٹھارہ کی تیاری میں اہم کردار ادا کیا۔

اوکاڑہ میں اپنے گرو کے پاس رہنے کے دوران ایک ٹرانس جینڈر خاتون پر ہونے والے تشدد پر آواز اٹھانے اور مقدمہ درج کروانے پر دو ہزار سولہ میں ضلع ٹوبہ ٹیک سنگھ کے علاقے مرید والا میں ایک میوزک فیسٹیول کے دوران ان پر تیزاب پھینکا گیا تھا۔ اس حملے میں وہ شدید زخمی ہوئیں اور مہینوں زندگی اور موت کی کشمکش میں رہیں۔ بچپن میں خاندانی مخالفت اور بے دخلی کے بعد انھوں نے تعلیم جاری رکھی اور بعد میں اسلام آباد پولیس کے ٹرانس جینڈر پروٹیکشن یونٹ کی انچارج اور جینڈر پروٹیکشن یونٹ کی اضافی انچارج کی حیثیت سے بھی خدمات انجام دیں۔

بین الاقوامی سطح پر بھی ان کی خدمات کو تسلیم کیا گیا ہے۔ سنہ دو ہزار پچیس سے دو ہزار چھبیس کے دوران انھیں ہارورڈ کینیڈی سکول میں گلوبل ایل جی بی ٹی کیو ہیومن رائٹس فیلو منتخب کیا گیا۔ اس کے علاوہ فرینکو جرمن پرائز فار ہيومن رائٹس اینڈ دی رول آف لا اور گالاز انٹرنیشنل ایکٹوسٹ ایوارڈ سمیت دیگر اعزازات بھی ان کے اعزاز میں شامل ہیں۔

stories.title: US Ready to Play Productive Role on Pakistan's Afghan Concerns
stories.summary:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that Washington has heard Pakistan's concerns regarding terrorism originating from Afghan territory. Speaking on Saturday in Atlanta during a press conference on the sidelines of the G20 foreign ministers' meeting, Rubio said the United States would play a productive role if there is one available. He noted that Pakistan feels the Taliban have not done enough to constrain attacks sponsored from Afghanistan.

Pakistan has repeatedly urged the Taliban administration in Kabul to dismantle militant sanctuaries, particularly those linked to the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan. Meanwhile, the Afghan Taliban have avoided a categorical stance on these groups while rejecting allegations that their territory serves as a base for attacks against Pakistan. On Saturday, Pakistan's information ministry criticized the Taliban's refusal to address cross-border terrorism, responding to remarks by Afghan spokesperson Zabihullah Mujahid that blamed Islamabad's policies for the ongoing conflict.

Diplomatic efforts to resolve the tensions have faced repeated setbacks. Multiple rounds of talks last year, facilitated by Qatar and Turkiye, failed to produce workable solutions, and China-led efforts this year also yielded no breakthrough. Furthermore, discussions during the Moscow Format consultations on October 5 ended without a joint communiqué due to disagreements over references to terrorist networks.

Border skirmishes have heightened bilateral friction, with Pakistan conducting airstrikes in September and responding to unprovoked fire from the Afghan side in Kurram and Lower South Waziristan's Angoor Adda in October. Foreign Office spokesperson Sajjad Haider Khan emphasized that talks with Afghanistan cannot be unconditional while noting Pakistan would welcome sincere mediation efforts by friendly nations.

stories.title: Slain Karachi Firefighter Shaheed Furqan Awarded Tamgha-e-Shujaat
stories.summary:
President Asif Ali Zardari has approved the conferment of the prestigious Tamgha-e-Shujaat, or Medal of Bravery, upon Shaheed Furqan. The national civil award honors the Karachi firefighter who gave his life while attempting to rescue people during the massive fire at Gul Plaza. The approval followed efforts by Karachi Mayor Murtaza Wahab to secure national recognition for the firefighter's extraordinary courage and selfless service.

Shaheed Furqan demonstrated exceptional bravery and devotion to humanity while risking his life in the line of duty. During the intense firefighting operations, he tragically fell into the wreckage and became trapped under debris. He had been married for a year and a half and had one child at the time of his passing.

The devastating blaze at Gul Plaza on Karachi's M.A. Jinnah Road erupted on the night of January 17, 2026. Firefighting crews battled the flames continuously for approximately 36 hours before the fire was finally contained on the morning of January 19. Furqan was part of the initial team that responded to the massive emergency on Saturday night.

The official recognition serves as a tribute to Furqan's professional commitment and supreme sacrifice. His bravery is remembered as a enduring symbol of dedication to saving human lives. Additionally, plans were made to name the Nazimabad fire station after the fallen firefighter.

stories.title: وسطی پنجاب کا فضائی معیار انتہائی مضر صحت قرار، لاہور سرفہرست
stories.summary:
عالمی ویب سائٹ کی رپورٹ کے مطابق لاہور، گوجرانوالہ اور فیصل آباد سمیت وسطی پنجاب کا فضائی معیار انتہائی مضر صحت ہو گیا ہے۔ صبح کے وقت گوجرانوالہ میں پارٹیکولیٹ میٹرز کی تعداد 612، لاہور میں 475، فیصل آباد میں 371 اور ملتان میں 350 ریکارڈ کی گئی ہے۔

صوبہ پنجاب کا دارالحکومت لاہور آج بھی دنیا کے آلودہ ترین شہروں میں پہلے نمبر پر موجود ہے۔ دوسری جانب کراچی کا فضائی معیار بھی متاثر ہوا ہے جہاں پارٹیکولیٹ میٹرز کی تعداد 173 ریکارڈ کی گئی ہے، جس کی وجہ سے یہ شہر تیسرے نمبر پر ہے۔

شدید آلودگی کے پیشِ نظر طبی ماہرین نے شہریوں کو خبردار کیا ہے۔ خاص طور پر بچوں، بزرگوں اور سانس یا دل کے امراض میں مبتلا مریضوں کو غیر ضروری باہر نکلنے سے گریز کرنے اور احتیاطی تدابیر اختیار کرنے کا مشورہ دیا گیا ہے۔

فضائی آلودگی کی اس خطرناک لہر سے نظامِ تنفس کے مسائل میں اضافے کا خدشہ ہے۔ انتظامیہ کی جانب سے اس صورتحال سے نمٹنے کے لیے مختلف اقدامات زیرِ غور ہیں تاکہ شہریوں کو اس زہریلے دھوئیں سے نجات دلائی جا سکے۔

stories.title: حافظ آباد میں آوارہ کتے کے حملے سے چار بچوں سمیت پانچ افراد زخمی
stories.summary:
پنجاب کے شہر حافظ آباد کے قریب چھنی کرم داد میں آوارہ کتے کے کاٹنے سے چار بچوں سمیت پانچ افراد شدید زخمی ہو گئے ہیں۔ ریسکیو حکام نے اس واقعے کی تصدیق کی ہے جبکہ اسپتال ذرائع کے مطابق یہ واقعہ اس وقت پیش آیا جب کتا گلی سے گزرنے والے بچوں پر جھپٹ پڑا۔

اسپتال کے ذرائع نے بتایا ہے کہ اس حملے میں زخمی ہونے والے بچوں میں سے تین کی حالت تشویشناک بتائی جا رہی ہے۔ زخمیوں میں سے ایک بچے اور ایک بزرگ کو ضروری ویکسینیشن کے بعد طبی امداد دے کر گھر روانہ کر دیا گیا ہے، جبکہ دیگر زخمیوں کا علاج جاری ہے۔

ابتدائی اطلاعات کے مطابق ایک خاتون کو بچانے کی کوشش کے دوران یہ تینوں بچے اس آوارہ کتے کے حملے کا شکار ہو کر زخمی ہوئے۔ اس واقعے کے بعد مقامی سطح پر خوف و ہراس پایا جا رہا ہے اور شہریوں نے انتظامیہ سے آوارہ کتوں کے خلاف فوری کارروائی کا مطالبہ کیا ہے۔

stories.title: Consumer Goods Companies in Pakistan Report Improved Sales Growth
stories.summary:
Despite rising food inflation, higher fuel costs, and weakening consumer purchasing power linked to Middle East tensions, several local and multinational consumer goods companies in Pakistan reported improved sales during the first nine months of 2026. Nestlé Pakistan recorded net sales of Rs160 billion, representing a 6.3 percent increase compared to the same period last year. The company credited its performance to brand investments, product innovation, disciplined pricing, and export channel improvements, while its net profit after tax rose 3.1 percent to Rs14.526 billion.

FrieslandCampina Engro Pakistan also experienced growth, with revenue increasing by 10.1 percent to Rs88.4 billion and profit rising to Rs6.5 billion. Similarly, Unilever Pakistan Foods reported sales of Rs37.6 billion and a net profit of Rs6.326 billion, driven by economic resilience, fiscal consolidation, and foreign exchange reserve improvements. Colgate-Palmolive Pakistan saw a 25.53 percent jump in sales to Rs52.7 billion for the July-September 2026 quarter, alongside an 8 percent increase in profit after tax to Rs4.9 billion.

Fauji Foods Limited achieved its highest-ever nine-month revenue of Rs23.9 billion, a 14.1 percent rise, although its profit after tax declined to Rs666 million. National Foods Limited reported quarterly sales of Rs11.1 billion and a profit of Rs888 million. During its annual general meeting, National Foods management projected a 15 percent revenue growth for the 2027 fiscal year.

Despite these positive financial results, many corporations maintained a cautious outlook for the remainder of the year. Executives pointed to persistent inflationary pressures, volatile energy costs, high interest rates, and regional conflicts as ongoing challenges. Rising shipping container freight rates, which climbed from $500-$600 to $5,000, and supply chain vulnerabilities regarding raw materials from Gulf Cooperation Council countries were also noted as potential risks to future export and operational growth.

stories.title: Imad Wasim Defends Babar Azam Amid Heavy Criticism From Fans
stories.summary:
Former Pakistan all-rounder Imad Wasim has strongly defended star batter Babar Azam, expressing deep disappointment over the severe criticism directed at him by sections of the local cricketing community, including fans and former players. Wasim asserted that Babar remains a superstar and one of the finest one-day international batters Pakistan has ever produced, arguing that his decade-long record of consistency and world-class performances should not be dismissed due to a temporary rough patch.

While noting that a player's current form and technique are entirely open to scrutiny and debate, Wasim stressed that criticism must remain strictly focused on cricketing matters rather than degrading into personal attacks. He accused critics of disguising personal agendas, jealousy, and character assassination as genuine analysis solely to gain public attention. According to Wasim, the nation's cricketing culture should focus on supporting and celebrating established stars during challenging periods instead of tearing them apart the moment they struggle.

In separate news from Pakistan, President Asif Ali Zardari has approved conferring the prestigious Tamgha-e-Shujaat, or Medal of Bravery, on Shaheed Furqan. The Karachi firefighter tragically lost his life while attempting to rescue others during the devastating Gul Plaza fire. This national recognition was secured following dedicated efforts by Karachi Mayor Barrister Murtaza Wahab to honor the firefighter's extraordinary courage.

stories.title: India's Chenab Infrastructure Push Threatens Pakistan's Economy
stories.summary:
Since India unilaterally suspended the Indus Waters Treaty in April 2025, New Delhi has pursued a long-term strategy to target the Chenab river and economically strangle Pakistan. By leveraging this treaty vacuum, India has expanded hydroelectric power projects in the Chenab basin from 3,263 MW to 7,620.5 MW with an investment of roughly 414.04 billion Indian rupees. This infrastructure push involves five megaprojects, including Sawalkot at 1,856 MW and Pakal Dul at 1,000 MW, alongside the controversial Chenab-Beas Link Tunnel Project designed to divert 1.9 MAF annually.

The Chenab river directly irrigates agricultural lands across more than 11 districts in central Punjab, which account for 22 to 25 per cent of Pakistan's national food grain output. Strategic control over water flows during peak agricultural seasons could cause a direct blow of $9 billion to $11 billion to Pakistan's economy. Instead of generating billions from rice exports, the nation would face severe trade deficits and be forced to spend scarce foreign exchange to import basic food commodities, endangering national food security and millions of farming households.

Beyond water security, India has historically worked to weaken Pakistan's economic foundations by lobbying within the Financial Action Task Force to block its removal from the grey list and disrupting regional platforms like SAARC. While Islamabad has actively pursued international legal and diplomatic channels, ground-level preparedness remains profoundly lacking. Pakistan currently lacks the modern water-storage infrastructure, optimized canal lining, and early warning systems required to survive sudden changes in river flows.

To counter this asymmetric threat, analysts urge Islamabad to complement its external efforts with urgent domestic reforms. Measures should include declaring a national water emergency, educating vulnerable agrarian communities in the 11 affected central Punjab districts, expediting dam construction, and modernizing irrigation systems. Without such immediate preparation, Pakistan risks surrendering its agricultural security and economic stability.

stories.title: India's Water Strategy and the Threat to Pakistan
stories.summary:
Following the unilateral suspension of the Indus Waters Treaty by India in April 2025, New Delhi has systematically converted the Chenab river into a long-term instrument of leverage against Pakistan. Although framed politically by the BJP-led government as correcting past mistakes, developments over an 18-month period point to a strategy aimed at exerting control over Pakistan's foreign policy and economy. India has used this treaty vacuum to construct a network of storage and diversion infrastructure, raising hydroelectric capacity in the Chenab basin to 7,620.5 MW backed by an outlay of 414.04 billion Indian rupees.

The strategic roadmap features five megaprojects, such as the 1,856 MW Sawalkot and 1,000 MW Pakal Dul projects, alongside the Chenab-Beas Link Project. With a budget of 23.52 billion Indian rupees, the link project aims to transfer 1.9 MAF annually from the Chandra tributary into the Beas basin. This infrastructure network grants India substantial capacity to determine the timing and volume of river flows, posing a direct threat to Pakistan's economic survival and social stability.

The potential disruption of water flows risks devastating central Punjab's 11 districts, which form the core of Pakistan's rice-wheat zone and produce up to a quarter of the nation's food grain output. Disruptions during critical agricultural windows could inflict an $11 billion blow, forcing expensive food imports and threatening millions of farming livelihoods. This water pressure compounds previous Indian efforts to restrict Islamabad's access to global capital through the Financial Action Task Force and stall regional economic integration via SAARC.

Pakistan has largely responded on the external front through diplomatic and legal channels while experiencing a dangerous policy gap in domestic readiness. The country lacks necessary infrastructure like modern water storage, optimized canal lining, and real-time early warning systems. Experts emphasize that Islamabad must declare a national water emergency, educate vulnerable agrarian populations, and accelerate domestic reforms to avert severe agricultural and economic consequences.

stories.title: لاہور کے علاقے حاکم چوک میں شوہر کے چھری کے وار سے بیوی اور تین بچے زخمی
stories.summary:
لاہور میں حاکم چوک کے قریب گھریلو تنازع یا ناخوشگوار واقعے کے نتیجے میں ایک شوہر نے مبینہ طور پر چھری کے وار کر کے اپنی بیوی اور تین بچوں کو زخمی کر دیا۔ پولیس حکام کے مطابق یہ واقعہ اس وقت پیش آیا جب بچوں نے اپنی ماں کو بچانے کی کوشش کی، جس دوران وہ بھی حملے کی زد میں آ کر زخمی ہو گئے۔

واقعے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی پولیس موقع پر پہنچی اور فوری کارروائی کرتے ہوئے چاروں زخمیوں کو طبی امداد کے لیے قریبی اسپتال منتقل کر دیا۔ پولیس نے فوری طور پر کارروائی کرتے ہوئے مشتبہ ملزم کو حراست میں لے لیا اور اسے گرفتار کر کے مزید تفتیش کا آغاز کر دیا ہے تاکہ واقعے کے محرکات معلوم کیے جا سکیں۔

اس واقعے کے حوالے سے ابتدائی تفصیلات میں پولیس نے بتایا کہ حملے کے بعد علاقے میں خوف و ہراس پھیل گیا لیکن بروقت پولیس کی مداخلت سے صورتحال کو قابو میں لایا گیا۔ زخمی ہونے والے بچوں اور ان کی والدہ کا اسپتال میں علاج جاری ہے جہاں ان کی حالت کے بارے میں مزید طبی تفصیلات کا انتظار ہے۔

پولیس حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ ملزم کے خلاف قانون کے مطابق سخت کارروائی کی جائے گی۔ اس ضمن میں واقعے کی مزید قانونی کارروائی اور تفتیش کا عمل جاری ہے تاکہ گھریلو تشدد کے اس واقعے کے تمام پہلوؤں کو سامنے لایا جا سکے۔

stories.title: US acknowledges Pakistan's cross-border terrorism worries involving Afghanistan
stories.summary:
United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio acknowledged Pakistan's concerns regarding terrorist attacks originating from Afghanistan, stating that Washington does not want Pakistan to be a target of terrorism. Speaking in Atlanta at the conclusion of the G20 foreign ministers' meeting, Rubio noted that Pakistan believes the Afghan Taliban has failed to take sufficient action to prevent these cross-border attacks, prompting Islamabad to take matters into its own hands.

Rubio's remarks followed renewed criticism from Islamabad directed at the Afghan Taliban regime. Pakistan's Ministry of Information and Broadcasting rejected recent statements by Taliban spokesperson Zabihullah Mujahid, accusing the leadership in Kabul of deflecting blame and ignoring the core issue affecting bilateral relations. The ministry asserted that Pakistan would not tolerate terrorist sanctuaries operating across the border and maintained its right to implement all necessary measures under international law to protect national security.

Islamabad has consistently urged Kabul to take verifiable actions against militant groups, specifically highlighting the banned Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan, which Pakistani officials maintain operates from safe havens inside Afghanistan. Conversely, the Taliban authorities have denied accusations that they permit militants to utilize Afghan territory as a base for conducting attacks against neighboring Pakistan.

The diplomatic friction highlights ongoing regional security challenges and the strained relationship between Islamabad and the Afghan authorities. By publicly addressing these security apprehensions, the United States has formally noted the gravity of the cross-border militant threat facing Pakistan as regional tensions continue to persist.

stories.title: Pakistan Faces Ongoing Delays in Local Government Elections
stories.summary:
Local government elections across Pakistan continue to face persistent delays due to ongoing disputes between the Election Commission of Pakistan and various federal and provincial administrations. Since the 18th Amendment entrusted the ECP with holding local polls in 2010, authorities have frequently encountered obstacles in Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Islamabad Capital Territory, and cantonment boards. The ECP has found itself repeatedly altering schedules and conducting fresh demarcations as governments amend local government laws shortly before scheduled polling dates.

In Islamabad Capital Territory, the last local government election occurred in November 2015, and its term expired in February 2021. Despite court rules and multiple election schedules issued by the ECP, legislative interventions such as the Islamabad Capital Territory Local Government Amendment Ordinance have repeatedly reset the timeline. Similar legislative hurdles have affected Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, where terms expired in June 2026 and new amendments altered council sizes, prompting objections from the ECP over delaying tactics amidst security challenges in several districts.

In Punjab, all administrative preparations for local polls under the Punjab Local Government Act of 2025 have been completed, marking a potential return of local bodies after roughly 11 years. However, the provincial government requested a deferral until April 2027 due to dense fog and school exams, a request swiftly rejected by the ECP. Meanwhile, elections for 43 cantonment boards have also stalled because the ECP has yet to receive the required formal request from the federal government following the expiration of previous board terms in April 2026.

These recurring stalemates highlight a fundamental structural flaw: while the ECP is mandated to conduct local elections, federal and provincial legislatures retain the power to amend local government laws at will, even after election schedules are announced. To resolve this uncertainty, experts suggest amending the Elections Act of 2017 to prohibit legal changes after a local government's term expires. Additional complications, such as discussions surrounding new provinces or provincial status for Islamabad, threaten to introduce further delays.

stories.title: انڈین حزب اختلاف کی دہلی میں احتجاجی ریلی، الیکشن کمشنر کے استعفے کا مطالبہ
stories.summary:
انڈیا کے دارالحکومت دہلی کے رام لیلا میدان میں اتوار کی دوپہر کانگریس پارٹی کی قیادت میں تمام حزب اختلاف کی جماعتوں نے ایک بڑی احتجاجی ریلی نکالی۔ اس مظاہرے کا بنیادی مقصد انڈین چیف الیکشن کمشنر گیانیش کمار کو ان کے عہدے سے ہٹانے کا مطالبہ کرنا تھا۔ پولیس کی جانب سے جنتر منتر کو مظاہروں کے لیے بند کیے جانے کے بعد رام لیلا میدان میں متحدہ اپوزیشن کا یہ پہلا بڑا پاور شو تھا، جس میں ملک بھر سے آئے ہوئے رہنماؤں اور حامیوں نے شرکت کی۔

کانگریس رہنما راہل گاندھی نے اس مارچ کو ملک کی روح اور آئین کو بچانے کی تحریک قرار دیتے ہوئے نوجوانوں، طلبہ اور سول سوسائٹی کو اس میں شامل ہونے کی دعوت دی۔ اس ریلی کو کاکروچ جنتا پارٹی اور طلبہ تنظیموں کی بھی حمایت حاصل تھی۔ اس سے قبل ہفتے کے روز ملیکارجن کھڑگے کی رہائش گاہ پر اپوزیشن ارکان پارلیمان نے گیانیش کمار کا علامتی ’پبلک امپیچمنٹ‘ بھی کیا تھا، جس میں ان پر وزیر اعظم نریندر مودی کو فائدہ پہنچانے اور ووٹروں کے حقوق کو خطرے میں ڈالنے کے الزامات عائد کیے گئے۔

قانونی طریقہ کار کے مطابق چیف الیکشن کمشنر کو ہٹانے کے لیے پارلیمنٹ میں دو تہائی اکثریت سے مواخذے کی ضرورت ہوتی ہے، جسے اسپیکر نے مسترد کر دیا تھا۔ سیاسی تجزیہ کاروں کے مطابق اپوزیشن اب سوشل میڈیا بالخصوص انسٹاگرام کو موثر انداز میں استعمال کر کے نوجوان طبقے (جین زی) تک اپنا پیغام پہنچا رہی ہے۔ جون میں بہار سے شروع ہونے والی ووٹر فہرست کی نظر ثانی کے عمل میں کروڑوں نام خارج کیے جانے کے بعد سے یہ تنازع شدت اختیار کر گیا ہے۔

سیاسی ماہرین کا خیال ہے کہ اس تحریک اور ریلی کے ذریعے راہل گاندھی نے اپوزیشن کو ایک بار پھر مضبوط اتحاد کی شکل دے دی ہے اور وہ محض استعفے تک محدود نہیں بلکہ 2023 کی آئینی ترمیم کو مسترد کرنے اور مقدمات دائر کرنے کے مطالبات بھی کر رہے ہیں۔ دوسری جانب، حکمراں جماعت بی جے پی نے ان الزامات کو مسترد کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ کانگریس ملک میں مایوسی اور انتشار پھیلانے کی کوشش کر رہی ہے۔

stories.title: Islamabad High Court Restricts FIR Mentions in Acquittals
stories.summary:
The Islamabad High Court has ruled that police forces cannot include references to First Information Reports in character certificates issued to citizens who have been acquitted of criminal charges. Justice Ayyaz Shaukat issued the directive while deciding a public interest petition, ordering the Islamabad Inspector General of Police to establish a formal mechanism to prevent the inclusion of closed criminal cases in citizen character certificates. The court emphasized that individuals should not be forced to initiate fresh litigation simply to obtain documents reflecting their true legal status.

The case specifically ordered the removal of an FIR reference originating from the Shalimar Police Station from the petitioner's character certificate. The court clarified that while law enforcement agencies are permitted to maintain internal records for official purposes, disclosing this information on documents required by citizens—particularly for international travel—lacks legal justification following a final acquittal. Furthermore, the court rejected the police's characterization of the petitioner as having been merely 'discharged' during investigations, noting that such terminology undermines the legal status of an acquittal.

The bench concluded that displaying an FIR on a character certificate despite a formal acquittal violates several provisions of the Constitution of Pakistan, specifically Articles 4, 9, 14, and 15, which safeguard individual rights, liberty, dignity, and freedom of movement. The judiciary stressed that individuals processed through due process should not continue to face adverse social and legal consequences. Consequently, the Islamabad police chief was instructed to implement proper operating procedures to ensure acquitted citizens receive accurate character documentation without unnecessary bureaucratic or legal hurdles.

stories.title: US Administration Plans Deportation of Over 150 Afghan Immigrants
stories.summary:
The administration led by US President Donald Trump intends to expel more than 150 Afghan immigrants back to Afghanistan utilizing a route through Pakistan. This upcoming action, reported by American media following disclosures from three anonymous US officials, has raised serious concerns among advocacy groups who warn that sending these individuals back could put their lives in significant danger. The initial deportation flight could take off as early as Monday.

This development forms part of a wider immigration crackdown initiated by Trump last year, which involved travel bans targeting multiple nations, including Afghanistan, alongside efforts to strip away deportation protections previously awarded to Afghan nationals. Among those facing expulsion are family members of Afghans who aided the American military prior to the 2021 fall of Kabul, according to the advocacy organization AfghanEvac.

While direct deportations to Afghanistan are not logistically arranged by the US, the anonymous sources confirmed that Pakistan will manage the expulsion process into the country. Some of the targeted individuals had received special immigrant visas following the Taliban takeover in August 2021. The impending removals highlight ongoing shifts in US immigration policy affecting vulnerable allies.

This situation underscores the mounting pressure faced by former Afghan partners residing in the United States. Advocacy networks continue to monitor the developments closely as the first scheduled flight approaches amidst intense scrutiny from human rights organizations regarding the safety of the returnees.

stories.title: Turkish President Erdogan Condemns Black Sea Attacks on Civilian Vessels
stories.summary:
Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has declared that recent assaults directed at commercial ships in the Black Sea are completely unacceptable. Speaking during a joint news conference in Istanbul alongside Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, Erdogan urged both Russia and Ukraine to behave responsibly and avoid actions that heighten regional friction.

Ankara has previously put forward a formal proposal to Moscow and Kyiv aimed at halting strikes against civilian shipping, but noted that neither nation has acted upon it. Meanwhile, Zelensky pointed fingers at Russia for complicating the maritime situation and mentioned that regional security concerns dominated a significant portion of his discussions with Erdogan.

Erdogan emphasized that discussions focusing on the restoration of safe navigation routes will persist, expressing hope that an agreement would breathe new life into broader diplomatic paths toward lasting peace. He also acknowledged renewed momentum for ending the conflict diplomatically, highlighting US President Donald Trump's ongoing initiatives, and noted that upcoming tripartite talks involving Russia, Ukraine, and the US are anticipated to take place in the UAE in November.

In related military developments, the US State Department approved the sale of 500 Patriot missiles to Ukraine, a move awaiting congressional review. However, Zelensky cautioned that actual deliveries of the interceptor missiles could take a number of years, even as Ukrainian authorities grapple with rapidly depleting defensive supplies.

stories.title: LPG Prices Surge Past Official Rates Amid Supply Shortages in Pakistan
stories.summary:
Liquefied petroleum gas prices in the open market have climbed to double the official government rates in Pakistan. The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority announced an increase for November, setting the benchmark at Rs294,075 per tonne compared to the previous month's Rs279,341. This adjustment brings the retail price of an 11.8 kg domestic cylinder to Rs3,470, while the official rate per kilogramme sits at Rs294.

The state regulator explained that consumer pricing is tied to Saudi Aramco-CP figures and currency exchange values. Although the dollar rate saw a slight drop of 0.12 percent, a 6.47 percent increase in Saudi Aramco-CP drove the consumer price up by about Rs14.73 per kg. Despite these official metrics, open market vendors are charging up to Rs630 per kg, and company-operated franchises are demanding up to Rs400 per kg.

Industry representatives attribute the severe scarcity to border closures with Iran, noting that roughly 70 percent of the country's LPG is normally imported from Iran while only 30 percent is produced domestically. Irfan Khokhar, chairman of the LPG Distributors Association of Pakistan, urged authorities to address market manipulations, warning that the crisis will deepen.

Concurrently, the Pakistan LPG Marketers Association threatened a business shutdown starting November 16 if the government proceeds with a draft policy that excludes private sector input. Association Chairman Ali Haider criticized state-owned entities for failing to secure emergency imports despite collecting billions through the petroleum development levy, calling instead for the complete deregulation of the sector.

stories.title: صادق پبلک اسکول بہاولپور کے طلبہ نے تقریری مقابلوں میں شاندار کامیابی حاصل کی
stories.summary:
پی اے ایف کیڈٹ کالج لوئر ٹوپا مری میں تیسرے انٹرنیشنل انٹر کالجیٹ بائی لنگوئل ڈیکلِمیشن مقابلے کا انعقاد کیا گیا۔ اس پروقار تقریب میں ملک بھر کے 24 معروف تعلیمی اداروں سے تعلق رکھنے والے 48 شرکا نے بھرپور حصہ لیا۔

مقابلے کے دوران صادق پبلک اسکول بہاولپور کے ہونہار طلبہ نے شاندار کارکردگی کا مظاہرہ کیا۔ سید علی زین العابدین نے انگلش ڈیکلِمیشن جبکہ حسین سلیمی نے اردو ڈیکلِمیشن کے زمرے میں پہلی پوزیشن حاصل کرنے کا اعزاز اپنے نام کیا۔

انفرادی کامیابیوں کے علاوہ صادق پبلک اسکول نے مجموعی کارکردگی کی بنیاد پر پہلی پوزیشن کی ٹرافی بھی جیت لی۔ اس شاندار فتح نے ادارے کا نام روشن کیا اور ملک بھر میں اسکول کی تعلیمی و تربیتی روایات کا لوہا منوایا۔

تعلیمی ماہرین اور اساتذہ کا کہنا ہے کہ صادق پبلک اسکول کے طلبہ کی یہ محنت اور کامیابی آنے والی نسل کے لیے ایک بہترین اور روشن مثال ہے۔ اس طرح کے مقابلے نوجوانوں میں اعتماد اور قائدانہ صلاحیتیں اجاگر کرنے کا سبب بنتے ہیں۔

stories.title: Analyzing the Illusion of Political Popularity in Pakistan
stories.summary:
Political analysts and international media have long debated the true nature of public support for Pakistan Tehreek-i-Insaf (PTI), a party founded by Imran Khan in 1996. Initially remaining a minor political player, PTI rose to dominance in 2011 largely through a carefully engineered political phenomenon. According to political scholar Muhammad Waseem, intelligence agencies steered media narratives, weakened opponents, and guided influential political figures toward the party, creating what political scientists describe as "manufactured popularity" built on symbolic engineering and institutional sponsorship.

PTI leveraged a modern communication strategy pioneered by researcher Ifrah Nadeem, utilizing computational propaganda, emotional messaging, and targeted social media campaigns. This digital approach bypassed traditional journalistic scrutiny to portray Khan as an incorruptible reformer capable of establishing a new Pakistan. However, once Khan assumed executive power in 2018, the contradictions between idealistic campaign promises and the harsh realities of governing a country facing severe balance-of-payments distress quickly dissolved the illusion. Khan’s policy missteps led to a withdrawal of military patronage, culminating in his removal via a constitutional vote of no-confidence in 2022.

Even after his fall, PTI successfully transitioned its narrative from an incorruptible savior to one of moral victimisation, especially following Khan's arrest in 2023. Digital algorithms amplified performative acts of resistance, creating an impression of immense public mobilization. However, the limits of this sentiment-based popularity were exposed when the current coalition government recently imposed emergency measures and governor's rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, sidelining PTI's provincial government without facing significant street protests or public uprisings.

This disconnect between online sentiment and real-life political capacity illustrates a recurring dynamic in political science, as observed by scholar Samuel P. Huntington. Manufactured popularity driven by media manipulation and emotional appeals often fails to translate into tangible administrative competence and economic stability. Understanding this phenomenon provides vital insight into how digital visibility and actual street-level political power can diverge significantly during governance crises.

stories.title: Pakistan International Airlines Resumes Direct Commercial Flights Between Islamabad and Beijing
stories.summary:
Pakistan International Airlines has officially reinstated its air connection between Pakistan and China, with the inaugural flight departing on October 30. This development re-establishes direct air transit between Islamabad and Beijing, marking a vital milestone in bilateral aviation relations and demonstrating the airline's dedication to maintaining active services within the Chinese market.

Under the updated flight schedule, the carrier will manage a weekly route connecting Islamabad and Beijing every Friday, offering travelers a straightforward and efficient journey between the two capitals. The airline also intends to maintain competitive pricing structures while delivering consistent operational reliability. In a separate announcement, the carrier noted a temporary discontinuation of all European routes.

To broaden its regional footprint across China, Pakistan International Airlines has forged enhanced partnerships with three major Chinese carriers: Air China, Shenzhen Airlines, and Hainan Airlines. Through the specific collaboration with Air China, travelers gain access to convenient onward connections to various domestic destinations utilizing Beijing as a central aviation hub.

stories.title: Muslim Americans Push for Greater Political Voice Ahead of Midterms
stories.summary:
Muslim and Arab American communities are aggressively seeking a stronger political voice ahead of the November 3 midterm elections, with numerous candidates running for congressional, state legislative, and local offices across the United States. These political campaigns come amid intense national debate regarding American military support for Israel, foreign intervention, and overseas spending, particularly in the wake of ongoing conflicts in Gaza and Iran. The Council on American-Islamic Relations recently highlighted the election as an unprecedented opportunity for the population of roughly eight million Muslims living in the United States, which includes over 2.5 million registered voters concentrated in 12 states that could heavily influence control of Congress.

Estimates indicate that anywhere from 51 to over 100 Muslim Americans are contesting elections across approximately 23 states.
