Meanwhile, students like Sean Baker highlighted decaying campus infrastructure, pointing to the dilapidated condition of rooms at the Technical University of Berlin as a primary motivator for joining the protests.

German authorities have expressed concern over potential unrest, noting that the demonstrations coincide with Halloween celebrations. Officials are particularly wary of extremist infiltration, pointing to elements from the far-left and foreign extremist networks attempting to hijack the movement. Hesse Interior Minister Roman Poseck explicitly cautioned against replicating the violent riots, looting, and arson witnessed during recent demonstrations in France.

Amid these tensions, businesses along Berlin's luxury Kurfuerstendamm shopping boulevard boarded up their windows and planned early closures. Questions regarding the campaign's leadership have also emerged, prompting Germany's national school student umbrella organization, BSK, to distance itself and schedule a separate day of protest for November 20, citing concerns over the diverse mix of groups driving the current initiative.

stories.title: سکردو میں میاں بیوی اور دو بچوں کا قتل، غیرت کے نام پر شبہ
stories.summary:
پاکستان کے زیر انتظام خطے گلگت بلتستان کے ضلع سکردو میں ایک انتہائی ہولناک واقعہ پیش آیا جہاں ایک ہی خاندان کے چار افراد کو تیز دھار آلے سے گلے کاٹ کر قتل کر دیا گیا۔ پولیس کے مطابق مرنے والوں میں محمد اسلم، ان کی اہلیہ ہانیہ اسلم اور ان کے دو کمسن بچے چار سالہ مہدی اور دو سالہ زہرا شامل ہیں۔ پولیس نے شبہ ظاہر کیا ہے کہ یہ دل دہلا دینے والا واقعہ مبینہ طور پر غیرت کے نام پر پیش آیا ہے۔ واقعہ کے بعد سکردو میں بڑے پیمانے پر احتجاجی مظاہرے بھی کیے گئے ہیں۔

مقدمہ مقتول محمد اسلم کے بھائی خادم حسین کی مدعییت میں درج کیا گیا ہے۔ ایف آئی آر میں ہانیہ اسلم کے والد، بھائیوں اور ماموں کو نامزد کیا گیا ہے۔ مدعی نے مؤقف اختیار کیا ہے کہ محمد اسلم اور ہانیہ نے پانچ چھ سال قبل کورٹ شادی کی تھی جس کی وجہ سے لڑکی کے رشتہ داروں کی جانب سے ماضی میں بھی سنگین نتائج کی دھمکیاں دی جاتی رہی ہیں۔ اسلم سکردو میں ایک پیزا شاپ پر ملازمت کرتا تھا اور اس جوڑے کے دو بچے تھے۔

مقتول کے قریبی رشتہ دار اختر علی خان نے سب سے پہلے لاشیں دریافت کی تھیں۔ ان کے مطابق جمعہ کی صبح جب انہوں نے رابطہ کرنا چاہا تو کوئی جواب نہ ملا جس پر وہ گھر گئے۔ انہوں نے دیکھا کہ مرکزی گیٹ کھلا ہوا تھا اور کار پورچ سے لے کر کمرے تک خون کے نشانات موجود تھے۔ کمرے کا دروازہ کھولنے پر اندر موجود منظر انتہائی ہولناک تھا جہاں تمام افراد مردہ حالت میں پائے گئے۔

سکردو پولیس کے ڈی ایس پی صلاح الدین نے بتایا کہ یہ گلگت بلتستان کی تاریخ کے بدترین اور ہولناک ترین جرائم میں سے ایک ہے۔ ابتدائی شواہد سے معلوم ہوتا ہے کہ ملزمان پہلے گھر میں داخل ہوئے، خاتون اور بچوں کو قتل کیا اور پھر اسلم کے گھر پہنچنے کا انتظار کیا تاکہ اسے بھی نشانہ بنایا جا سکے۔ پولیس نامزد ملزمان کی گرفتاری کے لیے چھاپے مار رہی ہے اور اس سلسلے میں مزید تفتیش جاری ہے۔

stories.title: Crypto Exchanges Tighten Defenses Following Record $6.3 Billion Binance Hack
stories.summary:
Major cryptocurrency exchanges are swiftly enhancing their security measures and calling for industry-wide information sharing after a historic $6.3 billion hack targeted Binance. Coinbase reported making precautionary adjustments to its offline cryptocurrency storage systems, while Kraken stated it is actively monitoring the incident to glean defensive insights. Analysts and executives emphasize the urgent need for robust security as digital assets become increasingly integrated into mainstream finance under United States President Donald Trump's regulatory environment.

Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, was forced to halt withdrawals following Thursday's breach, which industry analysts and blockchain analysis firms TRM Labs and Chainalysis attributed to North Korea. Binance co-CEO Richard Teng explained that the sophisticated attack likely originated from a compromised software engineer's laptop, granting unauthorized access to withdrawal systems. Although hidden traces and erasure software hindered investigations, executives expressed confidence that Binance holds enough resources to absorb the losses without triggering wider financial contagion.

Major stablecoin issuers moved quickly to mitigate the fallout by freezing funds linked to the exploit. Tether froze nearly $1.57 billion associated with Binance, and Circle froze an estimated $800 million. However, foundational assets like Bitcoin and ether remain unfreezeable due to decentralized control structures. Market reaction was immediate, with Bitcoin dropping over 4 percent and ether falling more than 5 percent before recovering some ground the following day.

Security experts suggest social engineering tactics were likely utilized to compromise the employee laptop, prompting risk infrastructure firms like Circuit to plan expanded employee training. Concurrently, industry leaders are urging the creation of a real-time, coordinated alert system. OKX CEO Star Xu advocated for a rapid-response network enabling participants to instantly share data during a breach and temporarily freeze suspected stolen assets to protect the evolving digital asset ecosystem.

stories.title: Kamindu Mendis Scores Maiden ODI Century to Lead Sri Lanka in Final
stories.summary:
Kamindu Mendis scored an unbeaten maiden one-day international century to help propel Sri Lanka to a competitive total of 325-8 in the tri-series final against Pakistan in Lahore. Playing on a slow-paced Gaddafi Stadium pitch, Pakistan won the toss and elected to field first, putting the visiting team into bat.

Kamindu anchored the innings with a brilliant knock of 131 runs off 128 deliveries, featuring 12 fours and two sixes, surpassing his previous highest ODI score of 64. He received strong support from in-form batsman Pavan Rathnayake, who contributed 77 runs. The pair formed a crucial 146-run partnership for the third wicket after opening batsman Avishka Fernando added 38 runs in an initial 87-run stand that spanned under 18 overs.

Pakistan fought back through their bowling attack, notably during the final five overs where they restricted Sri Lanka by taking three wickets for just 38 runs. Spinner Salman Agha claimed 2-44, while Pakistan captain Shaheen Shah Afridi finished with 2-50, breaking the dangerous partnership by dismissing both Kamindu and Dasun Shanaka in the span of two overs. Fast bowlers Haris Rauf and Naseem Shah also contributed with two wickets each.

Set a target of 326 to win, Sri Lanka's formidable total was built upon solid partnerships and Kamindu's standout performance. The match marks the culmination of the tri-series tournament hosted at the Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore.

stories.title: Kamindu Mendis Centuries to Set Pakistan 326 in Tri-Series Final
stories.summary:
Sri Lanka posted a challenging total of 325 in the One-day International tri-nation series final against Pakistan at the Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore on Saturday, October 31, 2026. Left-hander Kamindu Mendis led the innings with a brilliant 131 runs off 128 deliveries, marking his maiden ODI century. After a solid, risk-free start by openers Kamindu and Avishka Fernando that surpassed 50 runs in the first 10 overs, Pakistan claimed early breakthroughs through Salman Ali Agha, who removed Avishka leg-before and caught Kusal Mendis on a return drive.

Following these dismissals, Kamindu took control of the middle overs and combined with Pavan Rathnayake for a vital 146-run partnership for the third wicket. Rathnayake contributed a steady half-century from 47 balls using effective pull and sweep shots. At 238-2 after 40 overs, Sri Lanka appeared well-positioned to approach or exceed 350 runs, but Pakistan mounted a comeback during the death overs. Captain Shaheen Shah Afridi trapped Kamindu leg-before in the 42nd over and subsequently dismissed Dasun Shanaka.

Additional wickets from Haris Rauf and Naseem Shah restricted Sri Lanka's late-inning acceleration, though a wayward penultimate over permitted the visitors to cross the 320-mark and finish on 325. The performance left Pakistan with a target of 326 to secure the championship title in the concluding match of the series.

stories.title: Box Office Battle Intensifies Between Documentaries and Horror Films
stories.summary:
A24's documentary feature "You Can See Everything" and DC Studios' body horror film "Clayface" are locked in a tight race for the top spot at the North American box office during the Halloween weekend. The Elizabeth Holmes documentary, directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim, is estimated to capture $10.6 million in its third weekend, pushing it into the No. 1 position for the first time. The film has grossed approximately $63 million domestically and generated speculation about a potential Academy Award nomination for Best Picture.

Trailing closely behind is "Clayface," an R-rated DC production directed by James Watkins and starring Tom Rhys Harries, which is projected to earn $10.2 million in its second weekend. This represents a 57% drop from its opening, bringing its 10-day domestic total to $44 million against a reported $40 million production budget. The movie follows an aspiring actor dealing with a disastrous medical procedure.

Further down the box office rankings, Laika's animated fantasy "Wildwood" is expected to claim third place with $6.8 million, accumulating a 10-day domestic total of $25 million. Meanwhile, Black Bear's "Wicker," starring Olivia Colman and Alexander Skarsgård, is projected to bring in $4.1 million for a total of $13.2 million, and Paramount's "Street Fighter" rounds out the top five with an estimated $3.5 million.

The close competition highlights a busy Halloween weekend driven by both mainstream releases and unexpected box office breakouts. Studios continue to monitor these performances closely as the domestic market navigates the late-October theatrical slate.

stories.title: چیئرمین پی سی بی محسن نقوی کا سہ ملکی ٹورنامنٹ جیتنے پر قومی ٹیم کو خراج تحسین
stories.summary:
لاہور کے قذافی اسٹیڈیم میں کھیلے گئے دلچسپ سہ ملکی ٹورنامنٹ کے فائنل میں پاکستان نے شاندار کارکردگی کا مظاہرہ کرتے ہوئے سری لنکا کو تین وکٹوں سے شکست دے دی۔ اس کامیابی کے بعد پاکستان کرکٹ بورڈ کے چیئرمین محسن نقوی نے پوری قومی ٹیم کو زبردست الفاظ میں شاباش دی۔

چیئرمین پی سی بی محسن نقوی نے اپنے جاری کردہ بیان میں کہا کہ فائنل میچ میں پاکستانی کھلاڑیوں نے بہترین کھیل پیش کرتے ہوئے سری لنکا کو آؤٹ کلاس کیا۔ انہوں نے خاص طور پر فخر زمان، عرفات منہاس اور سعد بیگ کی جارحانہ بیٹنگ کو سراہا جنہوں نے ٹیم کی فتح میں نمایاں اور کلیدی کردار ادا کیا۔

صدر مملکت آصف علی زرداری نے بھی اس کامیابی پر قومی ٹیم، کھلاڑیوں اور ٹیم مینجمنٹ کو مبارکباد پیش کی۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ کھلاڑیوں کی محنت اور شاندار ٹیم ورک کی بدولت یہ کامیابی حاصل ہوئی ہے جو کہ پوری قوم کے لیے انتہائی مسرت کا باعث ہے۔

اس کے علاوہ گورنر خیبر پختونخوا، وزیر اعلیٰ سندھ اور پیپلز پارٹی کی رہنما شیری رحمان سمیت دیگر اہم شخصیات نے بھی ٹرائی سیریز جیتنے پر قومی ٹیم کو مبارکباد دی ہے۔ پی سی بی حکام کو امید ہے کہ ٹیم فتح کا یہ سلسلہ آئندہ بھی جاری رکھے گی۔

stories.title: SECP Declares Thousands of Non-Filing Companies Inactive to Curb Misuse
stories.summary:
The Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) announced on Saturday that it had marked 39,704 companies as “Inactive by Registrar” after they failed to submit annual returns and financial statements for four consecutive years. The measure is designed to improve the reliability of the corporate register, prevent dormant entities from being misused, and strengthen defenses against money laundering and terrorist financing. Companies given this inactive status will have the designation visible to banks and other stakeholders in the SECP system, blocking them from opening new bank accounts, accessing financial services, or registering changes in directors until overdue filings are completed.

The affected companies are distributed across various regions, including 13,927 in Lahore, 13,859 in Islamabad, 4,868 in Karachi, 2,031 in Peshawar, 1,861 in Multan, 1,384 in Faisalabad, 1,102 in Gilgit, 436 in Quetta, and 236 in Sukkur. Under the Companies Act, 2017, filing annual returns and financial statements is a mandatory legal obligation to maintain transparent public records regarding company ownership and management.

SECP Chairman Dr Kabir Ahmed Sidhu emphasized that a clean and credible registry forms the foundation of trust within the corporate sector, balancing the protection of the financial system with opportunities for companies to regain compliance. Official figures indicate that Pakistan's corporate register totaled 317,002 registered companies at the end of September 2026, with 43,559 new entities incorporated during the previous financial year through fully digital name reservation and online registration processes.

stories.title: فخر زمان نے سری لنکا کیخلاف فائنل میں سنچری بنا کر سعید انور کا ریکارڈ برابر کردیا
stories.summary:
قومی کرکٹ ٹیم کے اوپنر فخر زمان نے سہ ملکی ون ڈے سیریز کے فائنل میں سری لنکا کے خلاف شاندار کارکردگی کا مظاہرہ کرتے ہوئے سابق کپتان سعید انور کا ایک بڑا ریکارڈ برابر کر دیا ہے۔ لاہور کے قذافی اسٹیڈیم میں کھیلے گئے اس فائنل میچ میں انہوں نے ذمہ دارانہ اور بہترین کھیل پیش کیا۔

میچ کے دوران فخر زمان نے جارحانہ انداز اپناتے ہوئے 99 گیندوں پر 127 رنز کی شاندار اننگز کھیلی۔ ان کی اس یادگار اننگز میں 11 شاندار چوکے اور 6 بلند و بالا چھکے شامل تھے۔ اس سنچری کے ساتھ ہی ان کے ون ڈے کیریئر کی سنچریوں کی تعداد 12 ہو گئی ہے۔

یہ دوسرا موقع ہے کہ فخر زمان نے کسی ون ڈے ٹورنامنٹ کے فائنل میں سنچری اسکور کی ہے۔ اس سے قبل انہوں نے 2017 کی چیمپئنز ٹرافی کے فائنل میں لندن کے اوول گراؤنڈ میں بھارت کے خلاف بھی شاندار سنچری اسکور کی تھی۔

اس کارکردگی کی بدولت فخر زمان نے ون ڈے ٹورنامنٹس کے فائنلز میں دو سنچریاں بنانے کے سعید انور کے ریکارڈ کی برابری کر لی ہے۔ سابق لیجنڈ کرکٹر سعید انور نے پہلی سنچری 1993 میں ولز ٹرافی کے فائنل میں سری لنکا جبکہ دوسری 1998 میں سلور جوبلی انڈیپنڈنس کپ کے فائنل میں بھارت کے خلاف بنائی تھی۔

stories.title: Thousands of Youth Join Gen Gen-Z Protests Across Germany
stories.summary:
Tens of thousands of people participated in demonstrations across Germany on Saturday, as a youth-led movement inspired by protests elsewhere in Europe took to the streets to demand educational reforms and lower living costs. Organized by the campaign group "Gen Gen-Z regelt" across 34 cities including Berlin, Frankfurt, and Munich, the rallies opposed compulsory military service and called for increased investment in public health and education systems. Turnout fell below initial organizer expectations of 182,000, with police reporting up to 18,000 participants.

While largely peaceful, the demonstrations coincided with Halloween festivities, prompting authorities to warn about potential exploitation by extremist groups. In Hamburg, minor unrest saw some barricades set on fire, while businesses in cities like Berlin boarded up windows ahead of the events due to fears of violence similar to recent unrest in France. Federal interior ministry officials noted that elements from the far-left extremist scene and foreign movements attempted to mobilize support, heightening security concerns among regional officials.

The movement highlights growing economic and social pressures on younger generations in Europe's largest economy as demographic shifts strain pensions, public services, and infrastructure. Student participants criticized the poor physical state of university buildings and argued that the government has failed to address their concerns, offering only further cuts. Meanwhile, mainstream organizations like the national school student umbrella group BSK distanced themselves from the rallies, planning a separate day of action for November 20.

stories.title: Pakistan Military Cautiously Optimistic Regarding US-Iran Mediation Efforts
stories.summary:
Pakistan’s military remains “cautiously optimistic” about its ongoing mediation between the United States and Iran, according to Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) spokesman Lieutenant General Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry. Speaking in his first interview with Reuters following a high-level delegation visit to Tehran, the spokesman affirmed the positive nature of the trips while noting the continued presence of powerful detractors who benefit from conflict. The diplomatic push highlights Islamabad's active engagement in regional stability despite existing geopolitical hurdles.

Addressing potential expansions of the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, the spokesman stated that anyone sharing a vision of collective deterrence and regional peace is welcome, noting that any final decisions rest with the political leadership of the three principal countries. Regarding troop deployments to Saudi Arabia under the pact, he clarified that actions depend on future circumstances and political directives, reiterating Pakistan's firm commitment to defending Saudi Arabia and the holy sites of Mecca and Medina while maintaining neutrality in the internal Yemeni conflict.

On the domestic front, the spokesman discussed counter-terrorism measures following inquiries about military campaigns in the provinces. He explained that operations rely strictly on intelligence-based operations (IBOs) rather than large military-led campaigns, adding that the tempo and freedom of action for these targeted intelligence operations will see further increases moving forward.

stories.title: Auditor General Reports Significant Financial Irregularities Within Sindh Building Control Authority
stories.summary:
The Auditor General of Pakistan has highlighted widespread financial and administrative deficiencies within the Sindh Building Control Authority (SBCA) for the 2024-25 financial year, citing weaknesses in regulatory oversight, internal controls, and financial management. The audit report noted that the authority failed to maintain proper financial records or finalize annual financial statements. Furthermore, the Single Window Facility for building plan approvals experienced severe delays, with processing times increasing more than fourfold compared to 2019 standards.

The audit uncovered that construction permits were issued for multiple high-rise projects without acquiring mandatory No Objection Certificates for advertising and selling units, increasing legal risks and potential fraud for the public. Approvals were also granted to builders and developers lacking proper licensing from the SBCA or membership with the Association of Builders and Developers (ABAD). Additional financial concerns involved spending Rs37.4 million on private legal advisers without Sindh Law Department approval and paying Rs52.2 million to a consultancy firm for IT services with questionable transparency and compliance procedures.

Investigators also flagged irregularities regarding mortgaged plots pledged as security by developers, which were allegedly offered to the public for booking before project completion and occupancy certificate issuance. The report pointed to shortcomings in handling unauthorized building demolitions and deploying contractors lacking specialized technical expertise. Because the SBCA failed to produce essential financial and building-control records for scrutiny, the Auditor General recommended a formal investigation into the missing records, assignment of accountability, and departmental action to address the administrative failures.

stories.title: Iran Supreme Leader Warns US and Israel of Unrestricted Retaliation
stories.summary:
Iran’s supreme leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, met with top military commanders in Tehran on Saturday and issued a warning that any United States or Israeli attack would face an immediate, impactful, and geographically unrestricted response. Khamenei stated that the Iranian armed forces and nation will determine the timing and conditions for ending any renewed military or terrorist actions.

The warning follows threats of military action from American and Israel officials amid ongoing regional tensions. In response to these developments, diplomatic efforts are currently underway to prevent a resumption of fighting. A Qatari delegation arrived in Tehran on Friday for talks with senior Iranian officials, and US Vice President JD Vance reportedly sent a letter to Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei, at the direction of President Donald Trump to revive negotiations.

Iranian army spokesman Mohammad Akraminia cautioned that new American aggression would widen the conflict across a much broader geographical area. Meanwhile, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi declared that the country's armed forces will take action against anyone attempting to harm the Iranian population.

Iran has confirmed receipt of the letter from US leadership but has not yet announced a formal response. Mediators from Qatar and Pakistan continue working to broker a lasting agreement between the warring parties as speculation grows regarding the future of the Middle East conflict.

stories.title: Iran's Supreme Leader Vows Immediate Retaliation Against US and Israel
stories.summary:
Iran's supreme leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, issued a written warning on Saturday to the United States and Israel against initiating new military or terrorist strikes. Speaking through a statement published on his website and Telegram channel, Khamenei asserted that Iran's armed forces and people would dictate the timeline and conditions for concluding any renewed hostilities.

The directive was delivered during Khamenei's first reported meeting with senior military commanders, which included armed forces chief of staff Ali Abdollahi, army chief Amir Hatami, and Revolutionary Guards commander Ahmad Vahidi. Khamenei has not appeared publicly since assuming the role of supreme leader following the death of his father, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, in US-Israeli strikes at the onset of the Middle East war in February.

During the meeting, Khamenei instructed military leaders to ensure that any threat is met with an immediate, impactful, and geographically unrestricted counterattack. He also commanded the armed forces to update target lists to encompass all tangible and intangible assets belonging to the American-Israeli enemy.

The supreme leader's remarks coincide with diplomatic initiatives aimed at halting a return to warfare. A delegation from Qatar arrived in Tehran on Friday to hold discussions with Iranian officials following a reported letter sent by US Vice President JD Vance to Iranian authorities, to which Tehran has not yet replied.

stories.title: Global Dockworkers Launch Strikes Against Ports Using Facilities for Arms
stories.summary:
Dockworkers across 22 countries initiated strikes on Friday to protest against war and the utilization of port facilities for arms exports. Organizers estimate the industrial action could disrupt more than 40 percent of Mediterranean cargo and impact over two billion dollars in freight. The movement originated from unions in Italy, France, Greece, Spain's Basque Country, Turkey, and Morocco, and has since expanded to involve more than 25 unions across 113 ports.

Major shipping hubs slated for disruption include Hamburg, Valencia, Le Havre, Algeciras, Piraeus, Genoa, Tangier Med in Morocco, and Nhava Sheva in India. Participating labor organizations include ver.di in Germany, SIPTU in Ireland, 3F in Denmark, and CGT Ports et Docks in France. Pro-Palestinian campaigns like the Global Sumud Flotilla plan to execute coordinated water-based actions in solidarity, while Italian union USB called a 24-hour general strike across more than 40 cities.

The protests draw upon the Istanbul Declaration published in May 2026 by European dockworker unions, which demanded that ports stop facilitating weapons shipments to war zones. Italian harbors, particularly Genoa, have frequently blocked cargo bound for Israel and US military bases. Data from the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute highlights that Europe became the world's leading arms importer between 2021 and 2025.

Union representatives emphasized that ports have turned into forwarding bases for war, noting that approximately 15 Indian seafarers have died and many others have been stranded at sea due to the ongoing conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran, demonstrating the severe human toll of armed conflict on maritime workers.

stories.title: Pakistan Prime Minister Defends Governor's Rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
stories.summary:
Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif defended the imposition of governor's rule and an emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa during a meeting with PML-N parliamentary party members on Saturday. He stated that the measure was essential to safeguard human lives, the regional economy, and society after negotiations failed. According to the prime minister, a joint committee of the Pakistan Peoples Party and PML-N held 48 hours of talks, but the provincial administration did not approve the agreed draft, leaving the government with no other choice.

Sharif criticized the performance of the provincial government over the past 13 years, arguing that political slogans and sit-ins had taken precedence over public service. He questioned how approximately 800 billion rupees allocated under the 2010 National Finance Commission Award had been utilized, pointing to unbuilt infrastructure, vacant police positions, and a lack of modern equipment for the Counter Terrorism Department. He also invited political forces to unite against terrorism, noting that Pakistan had previously eliminated the threat by 2017-18 through joint state and national efforts.

Highlighting the human and economic toll of militancy, Sharif stated that terrorism had cost Pakistan around 80,000 lives and between 150 billion and 200 billion dollars in economic losses. He claimed that thousands of individuals had died in terrorist attacks over the past two and a half years due to a resurgence of militancy linked to the relocation of terrorists from Afghanistan. 

Addressing economic and welfare initiatives, Sharif noted that the leadership had worked to stabilize national finances and launched a fuel subsidy scheme benefiting 13 million people despite budgetary constraints. He also announced plans to construct Danish schools in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa districts such as Chitral, Haripur, Mansehra, Bajaur, and Shangla to provide education for underprivileged children.

stories.title: HBO Max Releases Surprise 'IT: Welcome to Derry' Halloween Special
stories.summary:
Streaming service HBO Max surprised audiences by releasing a special 30-minute episode of 'IT: Welcome to Derry' on October 31. Titled 'IT: Welcome to Derry – A Story of Derry', the special instalment arrived on the platform on Halloween, providing fans with fresh content as they anticipate the arrival of the horror series' second season.

The narrative of the special takes viewers hundreds of years into the past, following three Indigenous youngsters who enter the Western Wood and encounter a hostile ancient spirit. This storyline explores the historical roots of the supernatural entity that eventually manifests as Pennywise, the shape-shifting character originally brought to the screen by Bill Skarsgård. The episode features a cast including Kiawentiio, Brandon Oakes, Isabel Deroy-Olson, Michael Podemski-Bedard, Morningstar Angeline, Jennifer Podemski, Brenda Odjick, Jennifer Guerrero, Zahn McClarnon, and Eric Trask. It was written by Cherie Dimaline and Jasmyne Flournoy and directed by Tazbah Chavez.

This surprise launch follows the official renewal of 'IT: Welcome to Derry' for a second season, which was announced in August. The upcoming second season will shift its setting back to the year 1935 during the Great Depression, focusing on the historical massacre of the Bradley Gang, a group of bank robbers who stop in Derry for ammunition before confronting terrifying forces. The television series acts as a prequel to the cinematic adaptations released in 2017 and 2019, which were based on Stephen King's 1986 novel. While the first season took place in 1962, the new Halloween special offers viewers an additional look into the dark background of the fictional town.

stories.title: West Indies defeat Bangladesh by eight wickets in opening Test match
stories.summary:
The West Indies secured an eight-wicket triumph over Bangladesh on Saturday at the Sher-e-Bangla National Stadium in Mirpur, claiming a 1-0 lead in the two-match Test series. Brandon King played a pivotal role by scoring an unbeaten 81 runs off 115 balls, guiding the visitors to their 170-run target in 35.1 overs on the fourth day. Bangladesh had been bowled out for 142 in their second innings, aided by bowler Jomel Warrican, who took 4-63, and captain Roston Chase, who claimed 5-36.

Bangladesh began the fourth day at 79-6 with a 106-run lead, but their batting lineup struggled to build a formidable target. Nayeem Hasan provided late resistance by scoring his maiden Test half-century, making 52 runs from 91 deliveries before being dismissed by Chase. Despite surviving earlier dropped catches, Nayeem's effort concluded when Joshua Bishop caught him off a shot toward long-on, wrapping up the home side's innings swiftly.

Following the dismissal, West Indies openers King and John Campbell initiated the run chase with a solid 64-run partnership before rain and subsequent bad light caused interruptions. Although King was dropped on 70 by substitute fielder Ebadot Hossain, he capitalized on the chance alongside Campbell, who contributed 49 runs before being bowled by Shoriful Islam. The victory underscored a strong collective comeback by the visiting team after a difficult start in the fixture.

Bangladesh captain Najmul Hossain Shanto acknowledged that his squad failed to execute their strategies adequately across all departments, noting particular shortcomings in fielding performance. Both teams are scheduled to meet for the second and final Test match in Sylhet, which begins on November 5.

stories.title: وزیراعظم کی زیر صدارت اجلاس، دانش اسکولوں کی تعمیر کا جائزہ
stories.summary:
وزیراعظم شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت لاہور میں ایک اہم آن لائن اجلاس زوم کے ذریعے منعقد ہوا۔ اس اجلاس کا بنیادی مقصد ملک بھر میں دانش اسکولوں کی تعمیر میں ہونے والی پیش رفت کا تفصیلی جائزہ لینا تھا۔ اجلاس میں وفاقی وزرا احسن اقبال، احد چیمہ، عطا تارڑ، شزا فاطمہ اور مصدق مسعود ملک نے بھی شرکت کی اور متعلقہ حکام نے وزیراعظم کو امور سے آگاہ کیا۔

اجلاس کے دوران وزیراعظم کو گلگت بلتستان، آزاد کشمیر، سندھ اور بلوچستان میں دانش اسکولوں کی تعمیر کے حوالے سے اب تک کی کارکردگی پر بریفنگ دی گئی۔ صورت حال کا جائزہ لیتے ہوئے وزیراعظم نے واضح کیا کہ دانش اسکولوں کے معیار پر کسی بھی قسم کا سمجھوتہ قابل قبول نہیں ہوگا۔ انہوں نے ہدایت جاری کی کہ ان اسکولوں کی تعمیر کا کام تیز کیا جائے اور تعمیراتی سرگرمیاں چوبیس گھنٹے جاری رکھی جائیں۔

وزیراعظم نے اس امر پر زور دیا کہ ان تعلیمی اداروں میں معاشرے کے انتہائی غریب اور مستحق گھرانوں کے بچوں کو داخلہ فراہم کیا جائے گا تاکہ انہیں معیاری تعلیم کے مواقع مل سکیں۔ حکومت ملک کے پسماندہ حصوں میں غریب بچوں کے لیے تعلیمی سہولیات بہتر بنانے پر خصوصی توجہ دے رہی ہے اور اسی مقصد کے تحت دانش اسکولوں کے منصوبے پر تیزی سے عمل درآمد کیا جا رہا ہے۔

اس آن لائن اجلاس میں وفاقی وزرا اور متعلقہ حکام نے شرکت کی اور ملک کے مختلف حصوں میں جاری تعلیمی منصوبوں کی بروقت تکمیل کے لیے تجاویز پر غور کیا۔ وزیراعظم کی جانب سے دی گئی ہدایات کا مقصد تمام زیرِ تعمیر اسکولوں کے منصوبوں کو مقررہ معیار اور مدت کے اندر مکمل کرنا ہے۔

stories.title: عمر عبداللہ کی دوسری شادی پر فواد چوہدری کا دلچسپ تبصرہ
stories.summary:
مقبوضہ جموں و کشمیر کے وزیر اعلیٰ عمر عبداللّٰہ نے اپنی دوسری شادی کا اعلان سوشل میڈیا کے ذریعے کیا ہے۔ انہوں نے معروف بھارتی صحافی اور سابق ٹی وی اینکر ندھی رازدان سے شادی کی ہے۔ یہ شادی ان کی پہلی اہلیہ پائل عبداللّٰہ سے طلاق کے تقریباً تین ماہ بعد عمل میں آئی ہے۔

بھارتی سپریم کورٹ نے 31 جولائی 2026 کو دونوں کی باہمی رضامندی سے شادی ختم کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا تھا۔ عمر عبداللّٰہ اور پائل کی شادی 1994 میں ہوئی تھی، اور ان کی ملاقات نئی دہلی کے اوبرائے ہوٹل میں ملازمت کے دوران ہوئی تھی۔ ان کے دو بیٹے ہیں جن کے نام ظاہر اور ضمیر ہیں۔

اس شادی کے حوالے سے سابق وفاقی وزیر فواد چوہدری نے سوشل میڈیا پر اپنے پیغام میں عمر عبداللّٰہ کو مبارکباد دی۔ انہوں نے اپنے تبصرے میں لکھا کہ عشق تو ناکام ہوگیا نا، شادی ہوگئی، مبارک ہو بہت بہت۔

اس خبر کے پس منظر اور ذاتی نوعیت کے اس واقعے نے سیاسی حلقوں اور سوشل میڈیا پر خاصی توجہ حاصل کی ہے۔ عمر عبداللّٰہ کا شمار خطے کے نمایاں سیاسی رہنماؤں میں ہوتا ہے، اور ان کی ذاتی زندگی کے اس اہم موڑ پر مختلف شخصیات کی جانب سے تبصرے سامنے آئے ہیں۔

stories.title: حیدرآباد: علمدار چوک روڈ سے تمام بجلی کے کھمبے ہٹا دیے گئے
stories.summary:
حیدرآباد میں قاسم آباد علمدار چوک تک نئی تعمیر شدہ سڑک کے درمیان سے بجلی کے تمام پولز ہٹا دیے گئے ہیں۔ سندھ حکومت کی جانب سے تعمیر کردہ اس سڑک کو بغیر کھمبے ہٹائے عوام کے لیے کھول دیا گیا تھا، جس کی وجہ سے شہریوں کو شدید مشکلات کا سامنا تھا اور حادثات بھی رونما ہو رہے تھے۔

اس صورتحال پر حیسکو نے بھی سڑک کی تعمیر پر سوال اٹھایا تھا، جبکہ جیو نیوز کی جانب سے خبر نشر کیے جانے کے بعد فوری طور پر بجلی کے پولز ہٹانے کا عمل شروع کیا گیا۔ سپرنٹنڈنٹ انجینئر حیسکو عقیل نور نے بتایا کہ اس شاہراہ پر ایک سو بجلی کے پولز نصب تھے جو مختلف علاقوں کو بجلی فراہم کر رہے تھے۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ یہ کام مشکل تھا لیکن کھمبے ہٹا دیے گئے ہیں اور باقی ماندہ کام جلد مکمل کر لیا جائے گا۔

حیدرآباد کے علاوہ سکھر میں بھی سڑک کے بیچوں بیچ بجلی کے پولز موجود ہیں جو شہریوں کے لیے پریشانی کا باعث ہیں۔ انڈسٹریل ایریا کو پرانے سکھر سے ملانے والی زیرِ تعمیر سڑک پر نصب یہ پولز مسلسل حادثات کا سبب بن رہے ہیں۔

شہریوں کی حفاظت اور ٹراف کی روانی کو بہتر بنانے کے لیے ایسے بنیادی مسائل کا حل انتہائی ضروری قرار دیا جا رہا ہے تاکہ اس طرح کے حادثات سے بچا جا سکے۔

stories.title: جناح اسپتال کراچی میں بجلی کی بندش سے آپریشنز متاثر
stories.summary:
کراچی کے جناح اسپتال میں بجلی کا سنگین مسئلہ چھتیس گھنٹے گزر جانے کے باوجود تاحال حل نہیں ہو سکا۔ بجلی کی طویل فراہمی معطل رہنے کے باعث اسپتال میں ایم آر آئی اور پیٹ اسکین کے اہم آپریشنز شدید متاثر ہوئے ہیں۔ گائنی وارڈ، نوزائیدہ بچوں کے انتہائی نگہداشت کے وارڈ یعنی این آئی سی یو اور ایڈمنسٹریٹو بلاک سمیت متعدد حصوں میں بجلی کی سپلائی متاثر ہوئی ہے۔

اسپتال انتظامیہ کا کہنا ہے کہ بجلی کی فراہمی معطل ہونے سے آئی سی یو سمیت مختلف شعبوں کے مریضوں کو شدید مشکلات کا سامنا کرنا پڑا۔ مریضوں کی زندگیاں بچانے کے لیے تمام ڈاکٹرز اور طبی عملہ پوری رات سخت محنت کرتا رہا۔ ایمرجنسی صورت حال سے نمٹنے کے لیے متاثرہ حصوں کو متبادل انتظامات کے تحت جنریٹرز کے ذریعے بجلی فراہم کی جا رہی ہے جبکہ گائنی وارڈ کا فالٹ دور کرنے کی کوششیں جاری ہیں۔

ترجمان کے الیکٹرک نے اس معاملے پر مؤقف اختیار کیا ہے کہ جناح اسپتال میں بجلی کی فراہمی میں تعطل اندرونی نوعیت کے فالٹ کی وجہ سے ہے۔ کے الیکٹرک کا کہنا ہے کہ اس اندرونی فالٹ کا ان کے اپنے انفرااسٹرکچر سے کوئی تعلق نہیں ہے، تاہم ان کا عملہ اسپتال انتظامیہ کی مدد اور اندرونی فالٹس کی درستگی کے لیے مسلسل رابطے میں ہے۔

بجلی کے اس تعطل نے جناح اسپتال میں صحت کی فراہم کردہ خدمات کو عارضی طور پر مشکل میں ڈال دیا ہے۔ جناح اسپتال کی انتظامیہ اور کے الیکٹرک کے عملے کی جانب سے اس اندرونی فالٹ کو جلد از جلد درست کرنے کی کوششیں کی جا رہی ہیں تاکہ مریضوں کو درپیش پریشانی کا ازالہ کیا جا سکے۔

stories.title: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei warns US and Israel over attacks
stories.summary:
Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei issued a strict warning on Saturday against the United States and Israel, cautioning them over any potential resumption of military or terrorist actions. In a published statement on his website, Khamenei stated that Iran's armed forces and citizens would dictate the timing and conditions for halting any renewed conflict if hostile attacks are initiated again by regional foes.

The warning followed a reported gathering between Khamenei and top military commanders, including armed forces chief of staff Ali Abdollahi, army chief Amir Hatami, and Revolutionary Guards commander Ahmad Vahidi. This marked the first publicly reported meeting for Khamenei since he assumed the role of supreme leader following the assassination of his father, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, during US-Israeli strikes in February.

During the discussions, Khamenei directed military leadership to ensure that any threat receives an immediate, impactful, and geographically unrestricted response. Furthermore, he instructed officials to update Tehran's target list to encompass all tangible and intangible assets linked to the American and Israeli adversaries. The ongoing regional hostilities initially began on February 28 with initial strikes on Iran.

The supreme leader's remarks coincided with active diplomatic discussions aimed at preventing a fresh escalation of warfare. A delegation from Qatar visited Tehran on Friday for diplomatic talks following an unaddressed letter sent to Iranian authorities by US Vice President JD Vance.

stories.title: خامنہ ای کی مسلح افواج کو تیاری کی ہدایت، دوحہ میں مذاکرات کا امکان
stories.summary:
ایران کے رہبرِ اعلیٰ آیت اللہ علی خامنہ ای نے مسلح افواج کے اعلیٰ کمانڈروں سے ملاقات میں ہدایت کی ہے کہ ملک کو درپیش کسی بھی خطرے کا فوری اور بھرپور جواب دیا جائے۔ انھوں نے خبردار کیا کہ اگر دشمن نے دوبارہ فوجی یا دہشت گردانہ کارروائی کی تو ایران جواب کا وقت، نوعیت اور طریقۂ کار خود طے کرے گا۔ خامنہ ای نے فوج کی دفاعی صلاحیت، انٹیلی جنس نظام اور جدید ٹیکنالوجی کو مضبوط بنانے پر زور دیا۔

دوسری جانب العربی الجدید اور ایگزیوس کے مطابق دوحہ میں قطری ثالثوں اور ایرانی نمائندوں کے درمیان مذاکرات میں پیش رفت ہوئی ہے، جس کے بعد ایران اور امریکہ کے درمیان براہِ راست مذاکرات کی بحالی پر اتفاقِ رائے پیدا ہوا ہے۔ اطلاعات کے مطابق ایک امریکی وفد مذاکرات کے لیے دوحہ پہنچ رہا ہے جبکہ قطری ثالث مسلسل وائٹ ہاؤس کے رابطے میں ہیں۔

ادھر پاکستان میں مائع پٹرولیم گیس (ایل پی جی) کی قیمتوں میں سرکاری نرخوں اور مارکیٹ کے درمیان بڑا فرق برقرار ہے۔ اوگرا نے نومبر کے لیے 11.8 کلوگرام گھریلو سلنڈر کی قیمت 3470 روپے مقرر کی ہے، تاہم مارکیٹ میں یہ اوسطاً 6264 روپے تک فروخت ہو رہا ہے۔ اوگرا کا کہنا ہے کہ درآمدی سپلائی میں تعطل اور ایران کے ساتھ سرحدی بندش کی وجہ سے ایل پی جی کی درآمد متاثر ہوئی ہے جس سے رسد کم ہو گئی۔

خطے میں کشیدہ صورتحال کے دوران ایرانی فوج کے ترجمان محمد اکرمینیا نے کہا ہے کہ اگر امریکہ نے کوئی نیا حملہ کیا تو جنگ کا دائرہ وسیع ہو جائے گا۔ ادھر سعودی عرب میں فضائی دفاعی نظام نے دارالحکومت ریاض کے علاوہ مشرقی اور جنوبی علاقوں میں دشمن کے ڈرونز کو فضا میں روک کر تباہ کر دیا۔ علاوہ ازیں ایرانی وزیر خارجہ عباس عراقچی نے جرمن چانسلر کے بیان پر ردعمل دیتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ اب کوئی سرخ لکیر باقی نہیں رہی۔

stories.title: Gold Prices Plummet in Pakistan Amid Global Sell-Off
stories.summary:
Gold prices dropped significantly across Pakistan on Saturday, driven by a sharp downturn in international bullion markets. According to data provided by the All Pakistan Sarafa Gems and Jewellers Association, the price of 24-karat gold decreased by Rs10,800 to reach Rs409,736 per tola. Simultaneously, the price for 10 grams of 24-karat gold fell by Rs9,259, settling at Rs351,282. In global trading, the association reported that gold values dropped by $108, bringing the price down to $3,872 per ounce. Silver prices in the local market also experienced a decrease, falling by Rs142 to reach Rs5,388 per tola.

The broader drop in precious metals occurred during a wider market sell-off, which included a sharp decline in technology shares. Market participants and analysts noted that fears over artificial intelligence investments failing to yield sufficient returns contributed to the volatility. Independent metals trader Tai Wong observed that precious metals faced difficulties enduring the stock market correction, while Commerzbank analysts suggested that the drop in tech shares may have provoked forced selling and margin calls on safe-haven assets. Despite this pressure, gold remains down roughly 30 percent from its record high of $5,595 per ounce reached in January.

While central bank demand has historically supported gold when prices dip below $4,000 per ounce, other precious metals like silver, platinum, and palladium have sustained deeper losses. Unlike gold, these alternative metals lack equivalent backing from central bank acquisitions and safe-haven investment demand. Traders pointed out that the steady downward trajectory for these additional metals signals a lack of immediate recovery indicators, reflecting ongoing economic and geopolitical uncertainties.

This domestic and international market correction happens against a backdrop of elevated energy prices, rising government debt, and regional uncertainties surrounding the Iran conflict. Market observers continue to monitor how these overlapping factors impact safe-haven assets and whether central bank interventions will stabilize precious metal valuations in the near term.

stories.title: Balochistan Dismisses 72 Doctors for Absenteeism via AI
stories.summary:
The Balochistan Health Department dismissed 72 doctors from government service on Saturday due to prolonged and unauthorized absences from duty. The dismissals were executed utilizing an artificial intelligence-based attendance tracking system recently implemented by the provincial government to monitor medical staff. According to an official notification released by the health secretary, the actions targeted medical officers in BPS-17 and senior medical officers in BPS-18 under Section 4(B)(viii) of the Balochistan Employees' Efficiency and Disciplinary Act of 2011.

With these latest actions, the total number of departmental employees dismissed for absenteeism has reached 200. Health Department officials disclosed that a total of Rs410 million has been recovered through salary deductions linked to unauthorized absences. Furthermore, formal explanations have been demanded from 11,000 employees who violated workplace attendance and disciplinary policies, while ongoing departmental proceedings target another 800 staff members.

Balochistan Health Minister Bakht Muhammad Kakar stated that the affected doctors disregarded repeated notices instructing them to report to their assigned posts. Highlighting a strict stance against negligence, Kakar emphasized that the administration maintains zero tolerance for staff absenteeism as part of broader initiatives to improve regional healthcare delivery. He noted that these structural reforms are being pursued under the specific directives of Chief Minister Mir Sarfraz Bugti.

The provincial government continues to track personnel presence across hospitals and health centers using the newly introduced digital monitoring infrastructure. Officials maintain that these measures are essential to ensure medical professionals fulfill their official obligations and provide accessible health services to the public across Balochistan.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz Criticizes PTI Governance in KP Amid Emergency
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif strongly criticized the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) governance in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) during a PML-N parliamentary party meeting held in Islamabad on Saturday. The prime minister questioned whether public funds allocated to the provincial government over a 13-year period had been utilized transparently for citizen welfare and basic needs. He argued that despite long marches, slogans, and political promises regarding dams, solar power, schools, and hospitals, the PTI administration delivered minimal tangible progress for the region's population.

The federal government imposed emergency and governor's rule in KP on October 11, citing the provincial administration's deliberate disengagement from counterterrorism efforts. Prime Minister Shehbaz highlighted that thousands of civilians and security personnel had suffered casualties amid a resurgence of terrorism over the preceding two and a half years. He noted that despite receiving substantial funds under a special National Finance Commission arrangement, the KP government failed to adequately equip law enforcement or strengthen the Counter-Terrorism Department.

Recalling past political events, the prime minister criticized the PTI for its historical protests, including the 2014 D-Chowk sit-in that postponed a scheduled visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping. He also condemned the handling of security matters that allowed militants from Afghanistan to establish a presence in Swat. Prime Minister Shehbaz detailed that negotiations held by a joint PPP and PML-N committee with the PTI broke down after failing to secure formal approval from former chief minister Sohail Afridi.

Following the parliamentary approval of the emergency measures, Prime Minister Shehbaz urged PML-N lawmakers in KP to concentrate on short-term welfare projects to assist constituents over the next six to twelve months. The intervention by the Centre follows prolonged political deadlocks concerning security strategies and demands by the PTI for the release of jailed founder Imran Khan.

stories.title: Syrian Foreign Minister Confirms Consideration of Makkah Pact
stories.summary:
Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani announced on Saturday that Damascus is currently evaluating potential membership in the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement. Speaking at the Manama Dialogue conference in Bahrain, Al-Shaibani indicated that discussions are underway regarding Syria's integration into the defensive alliance, which currently includes Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye. The pact, officially signed on August 7, mandates that an armed assault against any single member state is treated as an aggression against the entire coalition.

During his remarks, Al-Shaibani expressed Syria's solidarity with Gulf nations against regional aggression and condemned ongoing missile and drone strikes. He emphasized Damascus's commitment to avoiding threats to neighboring countries and criticized repeated Israeli operations inside Syrian territory, while reiterating claims over the Golan Heights and supporting Palestinian statehood. The diplomatic statements follow recent escalations involving Houthi rebel attacks on Saudi infrastructure, which prompted military deployments and defensive support from international partners including France and the United Kingdom.

Pakistan maintains two strategic security agreements with Saudi Arabia, including the Makkah pact designed for collective deterrence. The Inter-Services Public Relations director general clarified earlier this month that the alliance possesses strictly defensive intentions rather than offensive capabilities. Furthermore, military officials noted that the alliance framework does not legally preclude the inclusion of additional regional partners who share a vision for collective security and peace.

In August, following the formal establishment of the Makkah pact, the Syrian foreign minister traveled to Pakistan to meet with Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of Army Staff Field Marshal Asim Munir. Those bilateral discussions focused extensively on regional stability, security environments, and expanded military cooperation between the nations amid shifting geopolitical dynamics in the Middle East.

stories.title: Mckenna Grace Sought Advice From Josh Hutcherson For Prequel
stories.summary:
Actress Mckenna Grace shared that working on the physical and emotional demands of 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping' prompted her to contact former franchise star Josh Hutcherson for insight regarding his time on the movies. The 20-year-old actress portrays twins Maysilee and Merrilee Donner in the upcoming prequel, where Maysilee participates as a tribute in the milestone 50th Hunger Games alongside a young Haymitch Abernathy, played by Joseph Zada.

In an interview with PEOPLE, Grace noted that her physical self struggled to differentiate between the fictional trauma experienced by her character in the arena and the reality of production. Having previously collaborated with Hutcherson on 'Five Nights at Freddy’s 2', she decided to reach out to him to discuss the grueling nature of the franchise. Hutcherson, now 34, famously portrayed Peeta Mellark alongside Jennifer Lawrence in the initial four films released between 2012 and 2015. Grace mentioned that her outreach was driven as much by her longtime fandom as a desire for guidance, wishing to hear personal anecdotes about the cast's experiences at a young age and working under harsh conditions.

Hutcherson recounted his own demanding memories from production, including early arrival times and wading through freezing water during the filming of 'The Catching Fire'. Grace expressed that listening to those stories was a highlight of her journey on the project, despite admitting that focusing on fun anecdotes rather than practical advice was her main goal. 'The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping', which also stars Ralph Fiennes, Kieran Culkin, Glenn Close, and Elle Fanning alongside brief appearances by Lawrence and Hutcherson, is set to hit theaters on November 20, 2026.

stories.title: PIMS Medical Team Conducts Check-Up of PTI Founder and Wife at Adiala Jail
stories.summary:
A specialized medical team from the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS) visited Adiala Jail on Saturday to perform physical examinations on Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) founder Imran Khan and his wife, Bushra Bibi. The delegation, which included Dr. Muhammad Ali and Dr. Arif, along with accompanying paramedical staff, evaluated the incarcerated political figure and his spouse in separate assessments.

During the visit, the healthcare professionals carried out comprehensive physical evaluations, ran various diagnostic tests, and provided follow-up assessments for both individuals. Following the completion of the medical evaluations, Imran Khan was granted permission to meet with his wife before the PIMS doctors departed from the prison premises.

This recent health evaluation follows a previous visit in September, when a PIMS medical delegation led by Dr. Arif traveled to Rawalpindi's Adyala Jail to examine the former prime minister. Equipped with modern medical instruments during that earlier one-hour visit, practitioners checked his blood pressure, cholesterol levels, and eyes.

The routine medical evaluations are significant given the high-profile nature of the detainees and public interest in their well-being while imprisoned. Adiala Jail continues to house the PTI founder and his wife amidst ongoing legal and political developments in Pakistan.

stories.title: کیپٹن صفدر کے بیان پر مریم نواز کی ناپسندیدگی کا اظہار
stories.summary:
پنجاب کی وزیرِ اعلیٰ مریم نواز نے اپنے شوہر کیپٹن ریٹائرڈ صفدر کے خواتین سے متعلق ایک متنازع بیان پر سماجی رابطے کی ویب سائٹ ایکس پر ناپسندیدگی کا اظہار کیا ہے۔ مریم نواز نے تبصرہ کرتے ہوئے لکھا کہ دل توڑ دینے والی بات ہے کہ ایک عورت اور بیوی بند دروازوں کے پیچھے کتنی خاموش جنگیں لڑتی ہے اور ٹوٹ جانے کے باوجود خود کو مضبوط رکھنے کی ہمت کرتی ہے۔

یہ تنازع اس وقت شروع ہوا جب کیپٹن (ر) صفدر نے 29 اکتوبر کو چنیوٹ میں ختم نبوت کانفرنس سے خطاب کیا تھا۔ اپنی تقریر کے دوران انھوں نے کینسر میں مبتلا خواتین کے بارے میں متنازع الفاظ استعمال کیے تھے اور ساتھ ہی وکیل اور انسانی حقوق کی کارکن مرحومہ عاصمہ جہانگیر کے خلاف بھی نامناسب زبان استعمال کی تھی۔ اس تقریر کا ویڈیو کلپ سوشل میڈیا پر وائرل ہونے کے بعد صارفین کی جانب سے تنقید کی جارہی تھی۔

اس معاملے پر سوشل میڈیا صارفین اور سیاسی شخصیات کی جانب سے بھی مختلف ردعمل سامنے آئے ہیں۔ سابق وفاقی وزیر فواد چوہدری نے اس معاملے پر واضح موقف اختیار کرنے پر مریم نواز کی تعریف کی جبکہ دیگر صارفین نے بھی خواتین کے مسائل اور کینسر جیسی بیماری پر طنز کرنے کے رویے کی مذمت کی۔

یاد رہے کہ مریم نواز کی والدہ بیگم کلثوم نواز ستمبر 2018 میں گلے کے کینسر کے باعث انتقال کر گئی تھیں۔ عالمی ادارہ صحت کے مطابق پاکستان میں صرف 2024 کے دوران 43 ہزار سے زائد خواتین میں چھاتی کے کینسر کی تشخیص ہوئی جبکہ اس بیماری سے تقریباً 20 ہزار خواتین کی اموات ہوئیں۔ کیپٹن صفدر کی جانب سے اس معاملے پر تاحال کوئی ردعمل سامنے نہیں آیا۔

stories.title: Syria Evaluates Potential Membership in Mecca Defense Pact, Says Foreign Minister
stories.summary:
Syria is currently evaluating the possibility of joining the Mecca defense alliance, which groups together Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan. Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shaibani made the disclosure on Saturday while speaking at the Manama Dialogue conference held in Bahrain, indicating that formal discussions regarding Damascus's potential entry are underway.

The defensive pact was originally established in August in Islam’s holiest city, Mecca. Under the terms of the agreement, an act of aggression against any single member nation is treated as an attack on all three participating countries. Saudi Arabia serves as a primary backer of the current Syrian administration, which assumed power following the collapse of former strongman Bashar al-Assad's government in December 2024.

 Riyadh has recently been seeking broad international support to counter intensifying attacks from Yemen’s Houthi movement. These security pressures have prompted multiple foreign interventions. In August, French President Emmanuel Macron visited Riyadh to announce the deployment of French troops tasked with protecting a critical Saudi oil terminal from Houthi strikes. Additionally, the United Kingdom government revealed plans in October to dispatch British fighter planes to assist Saudi defenses.

Evaluating Syria's integration into the Mecca alliance matters as regional security dynamics shift and nations forge coalitions to counter persistent cross-border threats. The prospective inclusion of Damascus highlights the evolving diplomatic and military partnerships taking shape across the Middle East in response to ongoing conflicts involving Yemen's Houthi forces.

stories.title: Zendaya Recreates Halle Berry's Iconic 2000s Look for Halloween
stories.summary:
Zendaya paid tribute to Halle Berry by recreating the actress's vintage Lanvin outfit from July 2000 for Halloween. Stylist Law Roach shared photos of the look on Instagram on October 31, showing Zendaya wearing the exact yellow, brown, and white geometric printed string bikini top and low-rise trousers that Berry wore to the New York premiere of X-Men.

The ensemble was finished with pointed-toe heels and tinted sunglasses, closely mirroring Berry's original styling which also featured a belly chain. This tribute follows Zendaya's recent appearance at the 2026 Emmy Awards in September, where she debuted a short pixie haircut inspired by Berry's signature cropped hairstyles, drawing praise from Berry herself.

The Halloween recreation coincides with the beginning of Zendaya's promotional tour for Dune: Part Three, which is set to hit cinemas in December 2026. The actress has previously paid homage to other fashion icons, including wearing a vintage Bob Mackie design inspired by Cher in 2024.

stories.title: پیٹرولیم لیوی کے خاتمے پر حکومت اور جماعت اسلامی کے مذاکرات 3 نومبر کو ہوں گے
stories.summary:
حکومت اور جماعت اسلامی کے درمیان پیٹرولیم مصنوعات پر نافذ لیوی کے بتدریج خاتم وفاقی اور عوام کو ریلیف فراہم کرنے کے معاملے پر حتمی مذاکرات آئندہ ماہ کی 3 تاریخ کو ہوں گے۔ یہ بات جماعت اسلامی کے نائب امیر لیاقت بلوچ نے میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے بتائی۔

نائب وزیراعظم و وزیر خارجہ محمد اسحاق ڈار نے جماعت اسلامی کے نائب امیر لیاقت بلوچ سے واٹس ایپ پر رابطہ کیا اور انہیں 3 نومبر کو مذاکرات کے لیے بیٹھک کی دعوت دی۔ اس کے علاوہ وفاقی وزیر احسن اقبال نے بھی ٹیلی فونک گفتگو کے ذریعے اس میٹنگ کے انعقاد اور اس کے انتظامات کے حوالے سے آگاہ کیا۔

لیاقت بلوچ کا کہنا ہے کہ مذاکرات کا بنیادی اور اہم مقصد پیٹرول لیوی کا بتدریج خاتمہ اور مہنگائی کے مارے عوام کو ریلیف دلانا ہے۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ اگر حکومت نے عوام کو ریلیف فراہم نہ کیا تو جماعت اسلامی ملتان سے اسلام آباد تک بھرپور لانگ مارچ کرے گی۔

لانگ مارچ سے پہلے ملک کے مختلف شہروں جن میں کوئٹہ، میرپورخاص، بہاولپور، مانسہرہ اور سرگودھا شامل ہیں، عوامی جلسے منعقد کیے جائیں گے۔ ان احتجاجی مظاہروں اور لانگ مارچ کے انتظامات کے لیے جماعت اسلامی کی طرف سے باقاعدہ کمیٹیاں بھی تشکیل دے دی گئی ہیں۔

stories.title: UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham Open to Slavery Apology Rejecting Financial Reparations
stories.summary:
British Prime Minister Andy Burnham announced on Saturday that he is receptive to the United Kingdom issuing a formal apology for its historical involvement in the transatlantic slave trade. However, the Labour leader firmly dismissed the possibility of providing financial reparations, arguing that contemporary British citizens should not bear liability for historical atrocities committed in a different era.

Writing in an opinion piece for The Guardian newspaper, Burnham described the transatlantic slave trade as a brutal and barbaric violation of human rights. He expressed sorrow and regret for the immense suffering inflicted upon millions of individuals and acknowledged the enduring impact of slavery on the modern world. The prime minister noted that his administration desires a structured dialogue with affected communities, stating that listening to calls for a formal state apology forms a crucial element of this ongoing process.

The remarks precede the prime minister's attendance at a Commonwealth leaders summit in Antigua and Barbuda, scheduled from November 1 to 4. The discussions also coincide with a tour of the Caribbean by King Charles III, whose engagements have been heavily overshadowed by Britain's historical role in colonialism and the mistreatment of people across former colonies. During the initial leg of his visit in the Bahamas, King Charles similarly acknowledged the profound suffering of the past.

The UK has never formally apologized for slavery or agreed to financial compensation. Burnham maintained his stance that present-day Britons cannot be held accountable for heinous historical wrongs that occurred under different laws and in which they had no direct personal participation. Britain's historical accumulation of wealth through the slave trade formally ended when parliament passed legislation to abolish slavery in 1833.

stories.title: Information Minister Attaullah Tarar Proposes National Cybersecurity and Social Media Awareness Council
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Information and Broadcasting Attaullah Tarar proposed the creation of a National Cybersecurity and Social Media Awareness Council during the inaugural ceremony of Cyber Security Awareness Week 2026 in Islamabad. Organized by the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA), the event served as the platform for the minister to outline new strategies for safeguarding citizens against escalating digital threats.

The proposed council is envisioned as a collaborative body that could include provincial governments, federal ministries, divisions, and various other organizations as members. Minister Tarar pledged his complete backing for the initiative, emphasizing that a cohesive, whole-of-government approach is necessary to ensure continuous cybersecurity education and outreach across the country throughout the entire year.

To effectively combat technological risks, the information minister advocated for embedding digital literacy directly into school, college, and university curricula. He stressed the importance of a research-based system capable of regularly updating educational content to keep pace with rapidly advancing technology, declaring that digital literacy ought to be compulsory for every citizen. Furthermore, Tarar urged every organization nationwide to establish a dedicated digital literacy cell, adding that government officers and the bureaucracy should also undergo specialized training in this domain.

The proposal matters as Pakistan faces growing digital vulnerabilities and online threats, making institutional coordination and public education vital national priorities. By targeting both educational institutions and bureaucratic structures, the proposed framework seeks to build long-term resilience against emerging cyber challenges.

stories.title: Iranian Military Strikes Cause Billions in Damage to US Bases
stories.summary:
An Associated Press report has revealed that over 115 Iranian drone and missile strikes have caused billions of dollars in equipment damage across 26 United States military bases and other installations in the Middle East. Independent verification using satellite imagery and regional officials confirmed that the attacks initially focused on early-warning radar systems before expanding to hit aircraft, warehouses, and troop accommodations.

The widespread destruction has significantly altered the American military presence, forcing the United States to relocate critical assets like aircraft, communications systems, and air defenses out of the Persian Gulf region. Among the most severely impacted sites are installations in Kuwait, including Ali Al Salem Air Base and Camp Buehring, alongside locations in Bahrain, Iraq, Jordan, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates. The deadliest single strike during the conflict killed six soldiers at Port Shuaiba in Kuwait on March 1.

Military analysts highlighted the vulnerability of modern forces to large-scale, low-cost drone assaults. Particular concern has focused on the destruction of rare, expensive early-warning radar systems, such as a specialized unit in Jordan valued at approximately half a billion dollars and a $1.1 billion radar in Qatar, which are critical to the region's air defense infrastructure.

While the Pentagon's Sean Parnell maintained that US forces remain well-protected and strong, the escalating damage has raised serious questions regarding the adequacy of American regional defenses. As President Donald Trump weighs potential fresh strikes and Tehran vows major retaliation, experts warn that any resumption of hostilities could trigger even greater destruction and complicate future decisions about rebuilding damaged military infrastructure.

stories.title: Gold Prices in Pakistan Plummet Following International Market Drops
stories.summary:
Gold prices in Pakistan experienced a steep decline on Saturday, driven by a parallel downturn in international bullion market rates. According to figures provided by the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association, the cost for per tola of gold in the domestic market dropped by Rs10,800, bringing the rate to Rs409,736. 

Additionally, the price for 10 grams of gold fell by Rs9,259, settling at Rs351,282. This decrease follows a previous drop on Friday, when the per tola price had reached Rs420,536 after declining by Rs5,100 during the trading day. 

Internationally, the price of gold fell by $108, reaching $3,872 per ounce. Alongside the precious metal, local silver prices also saw a reduction, dropping by Rs142 to reach Rs5,388 per tola. 

These market adjustments directly impact local consumers and jewellers across the country, aligning domestic precious metal valuation with current global economic shifts and international pricing trends.

stories.title: Gold prices decline sharply across Pakistan following international market drops
stories.summary:
Gold prices in Pakistan experienced a steep decline on Saturday, driven downward by falling rates within the international bullion market. According to figures released by the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association (APGJSA), the local cost of gold dropped significantly across the country during the trading session.

The domestic price of per tola gold decreased by Rs10,800, settling at Rs419,736 or rather reaching Rs409,736 according to official pricing updates. Similarly, the price for 10 grams of gold fell by Rs9,259 to reach Rs351,282. This downward adjustment follows a previous decrease on Friday, during which the per tola rate had fallen by Rs5,100 to close at Rs420,536.

The local market fluctuations closely tracked international trends, where the global spot rate for gold dropped by $108 to reach $3,872 per ounce. Alongside the drop in gold values, the domestic market also witnessed a decline in precious white metal prices.

In addition to the drop in gold, the price of silver in the domestic market decreased by Rs142. Following this reduction, the per tola rate for silver was marked at Rs5,388.

stories.title: Trump Expresses Optimism Over Potential Russia-Ukraine Peace Deal
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump stated that a peace agreement between Russia and Ukraine could be close, expressing hope for a breakthrough prior to the December G20 summit at his Trump National Doral resort in Florida. Speaking during an interview with conservative commentator Benny Johnson, Trump indicated there was a strong likelihood of resolving the conflict, despite the deep hostility between Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.

Trump did not dismiss reports regarding a prospective Russia-Ukraine agreement at the upcoming G20 gathering, asserting confidence in the negotiation process. In addition to his remarks on Eastern Europe, Trump commented on international policy concerning Iran and Cuba. He reiterated Washington's commitment to stopping Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons, claiming that Iranian military capabilities had been heavily degraded and would be further addressed by the United States.

Regarding Cuba, Trump characterized the nation as a failed country and forecasted that its communist leadership would soon be out of power. He suggested that the US might focus its attention on the island following Venezuela, noting that Secretary of State Marco Rubio is keeping a close watch on developments there.

The administration's broader foreign policy agenda also includes plans to deport Afghan refugees to Pakistan, according to recent reports. These diplomatic and security developments highlight ongoing shifts in US foreign relations across multiple global regions.

stories.title: سندھ کے اکتیس شہروں کے لیے ماسٹر پلانز پر تیز رفتار کام جاری
stories.summary:
سندھ کے وزیراعلیٰ مراد علی شاہ نے اعلان کیا ہے کہ صوبائی حکومت کراچی اور حیدرآباد سمیت صوبے کے 31 شہروں کے ماسٹر پلانز پر کام کر رہی ہے تاکہ پائیدار اور ہمہ گیر شہری ترقی کو یقینی بنایا جا سکے۔ انہوں نے یہ بات کراچی میں منعقدہ 'سندھ سیٹیز فورم 2026' سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے کہی، جو سندھ ماسٹر پلاننگ اتھارٹی کی جانب سے این ای ڈی یونیورسٹی اور یو این ہیبی ٹیٹ کے تعاون سے منعقد کیا گیا تھا۔

صوبائی وزیر بلدیات، ہاؤسنگ اور ٹاؤن پلاننگ کے مطابق، سندھ کے 17 شہروں کے ماسٹر پلان مکمل کیے جا چکے ہیں جبکہ باقی 14 شہروں پر کام آخری مراحل میں ہے۔ حکومت کی طرف سے اب تک سکھر، لاڑکانہ، میرپورخاص، عمرکوٹ، مٹھی، اسلام کوٹ، دادو، نوابشاہ اور نوشہرو فیروز سمیت 9 شہروں کے ماسٹر پلانز کا باضابطہ نوٹیفکیشن جاری کیا جا چکا ہے۔

وزیراعلیٰ نے اعتراف کیا کہ غیر منصوبہ بند تعمیرات، ٹریفک کی بھیڑ، پانی کی قلت، نکاسی آب کے ناقص نظام اور موسمیاتی تبدیلی جیسے بڑھتے ہوئے شہری چیلنجز سے نمٹنے کے لیے ماسٹر پلاننگ ناگزیر ہے۔ انہوں نے بتایا کہ کراچی اور حیدرآباد کے ماسٹر پلانز کے لیے بین الاقوامی مشیروں کی خدمات حاصل کی گئی ہیں، اور کراچی کی پیچیدہ صورتحال کو درست کرنا کنسلٹنٹس اور اربن پلانرز کے لیے ایک بڑا چیلنج ہے۔

مراد علی شاہ نے ماضی کی غلطیوں کا اعتراف کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ تجاوزات اور یوٹیلیٹی کمپنیوں کی جانب سے انفرا اسٹرکچر کی منتقلی میں تاخیر نے ترقیاتی کاموں کو متاثر کیا ہے۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ زیر زمین یوٹیلیٹیز کی میپنگ کے لیے جی آئی ایس سروے شروع کر دیے گئے ہیں اور پبلک پرائیویٹ پارٹنرشپ کی مدد سے شہروں کا ڈھانچہ بہتر بنایا جا رہا ہے۔ سندھ ماسٹر پلاننگ اتھارٹی کا قیام بھی اسی طویل مدتی فریم ورک کا حصہ ہے۔

stories.title: انمول عرف پنکی کے چودہ مقدمات منشیات عدالت بھیجنے کی درخواست
stories.summary:
ملزمہ انمول عرف پنکی کے خلاف درج چودہ دیگر مقدمات کو انسداد منشیات کی خصوصی عدالت میں منتقل کرنے کی باضابطہ درخواست دائر کر دی گئی ہے۔ یہ معاملہ ایڈیشنل ڈسٹرکٹ اینڈ جج جنوبی کی عدالت میں زیر سماعت ہے جہاں حالیہ سماعت کے دوران وکیل صفائی اور سرکاری وکیل دونوں عدالت میں پیش ہوئے۔

دائر کی گئی درخواست میں استدعا کی گئی ہے کہ ملزمہ کے خلاف موجود باقی ماندہ چودہ مقدمات بھی متعلقہ انسداد منشیات کی خصوصی عدالت کو بھیجے جائیں۔ اس موقع پر سرکاری وکیل نے عدالت کو بتایا کہ چونکہ انسداد منشیات عدالتیں اب باقاعدہ طور پر بن چکی ہیں، اس لیے ملزمہ کے خلاف مزید تمام کیسز کو قانونی تقاضوں کے تحت وہیں منتقل کیا جانا چاہیے۔

عدالت نے فریقین کے دلائل سننے کے بعد کیس کی اگلی سماعت پانچ نومبر تک کے لیے ملتوی کر دی ہے۔ عدالت کی جانب سے بتایا گیا ہے کہ آئندہ تاریخ پر سرکاری وکیل کی اس دائر کردہ درخواست پر باقاعدہ سماعت کی جائے گی اور اسی روز ملزمہ کی جانب سے دائر کردہ بریت کی درخواستوں پر بھی دلائل سنے جائیں گے۔

واضح رہے کہ اس مقدمے میں اس سے پہلے بھی ملزمہ کے خلاف دائر کردہ تین مقدمات انسداد منشیات کی عدالت کو منتقل کیے جا چکے ہیں۔ عدالتی کارروائی کے دوران اب تمام متعلقہ قانونی امور کو ان خصوصی عدالتوں کے دائرہ اختیار کے مطابق آگے بڑھایا جا رہا ہے۔

stories.title: West Indies Secure Eight-Wicket Test Victory Over Bangladesh
stories.summary:
The West Indies secured an eight-wicket victory over Bangladesh in the first Test match on Saturday in Mirpur, taking a 1-0 lead in the two-match series. Chasing a target of 170, the visitors reached 173-2 in 35.1 overs on the fourth day after bowling out Bangladesh for 142 in their second innings. 

Brandon King led the run chase with an unbeaten, career-best 81 runs from 115 balls, hitting 10 fours and a single six. Opening partner John Campbell contributed 49 runs off 55 deliveries before being bowled by Shoriful Islam. Rain and poor light caused temporary stoppages during the West Indies' innings, but the team maintained momentum to seal the win.

In Bangladesh's second innings, resuming the day at 79-6, Nayeem Hasan scored a resilient maiden Test half-century of 52 runs from 91 balls. However, excellent bowling by the visitors dismantled the remaining batting lineup. Jomel Warrican claimed 4-63, while West Indies captain Roston Chase took 5-36, marking his fifth five-wicket haul in Test cricket.

With this decisive performance, the West Indies hold the series advantage. The second and final Test of the series is scheduled to be played in Sylhet starting on November 5.

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Criticizes PTI Governance in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif strongly criticized the governance of the Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa during a party meeting held in Islamabad on Saturday, October 31, 2026. Addressing the Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz parliamentary group, the premier questioned whether available provincial funds had been transparently utilized for public welfare over the past thirteen years. He argued that despite numerous slogans, speeches, and unfulfilled promises regarding dams, solar power, hospitals, and educational institutions, the PTI administration had accomplished very little for residents from Peshawar to Hazara and the southern regions.

The federal government instituted governor's rule and a state of emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on October 11, 2026, following weeks of political friction and a breakdown in talks. Federal ministers claimed the provincial leadership was deliberately disengaging from counterterrorism efforts and maintained ties with militant groups. Prime Minister Shehbaz stated that forty-eight hours of negotiations between opposition representatives and a joint PML-N and Pakistan Peoples Party committee stalled when a finalized draft failed to receive approval from the provincial leadership, compelling the Centre to intervene to prevent further damage.

The prime minister highlighted the severe human and economic toll of terrorism in Pakistan, noting that approximately 80,000 lives have been lost and the national economy has suffered an estimated fifteen trillion rupees in damages. He commended former prime minister Nawaz Sharif for implementing anti-terrorism policies following the tragic 2014 Army Public School attack. Conversely, he accused the PTI of staging disruptive protests and long marches—such as the 2014 D-Chowk demonstration that postponed a visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping—and faulted them for allowing militants from Afghanistan to resettle in Swat.

Prime Minister Shehbaz urged PML-N lawmakers in the province to concentrate on short-term welfare projects to rapidly improve local livelihoods, putting long-term schemes on hold. Less than a week after the federal takeover, a joint session of parliament approved the emergency measures despite strong opposition protests. The Prime Minister maintained that hundreds of billions allocated through special National Finance Commission arrangements should have been better invested in strengthening the Counter-Terrorism Department and local law enforcement to secure the province effectively.

stories.title: Michael Douglas Recalls Initial Doubts About Glenn Close in Fatal Attraction
stories.summary:
Actor Michael Douglas has revealed that he and the filmmakers behind the 1987 psychological thriller Fatal Attraction originally believed Glenn Close was completely wrong for the role of Alex Forrest. Speaking on The October 30 episode of The Graham Norton Show alongside Close, Douglas admitted that the production team initially passed on the actress despite her three Academy Award nominations because he could not picture her as a psychopath.

However, Close's agent insisted on an audition, and the actress ultimately proved her detractors wrong. Douglas stated that her audition completely blew them away, leaving the production crew feeling like total idiots and realizing they had never been so wrong. Close went on to star opposite Douglas as the obsessed lover, earning an Academy Award nomination for Best Actress.

The pair also discussed the film's controversial ending, which was altered after American test audiences reacted with anger to the original version where Alex slit her throat and Dan was arrested. Close recalled being asked to reshoot the ending six months later to have Anne Archer's character, Beth, shoot Alex after an attack on her family. Although initially opposed to the change, Close relented, and the altered conclusion turned her character into a heavily loathed cinematic figure.

The nostalgic reunion coincides with ongoing promotional activities for Douglas's memoir, One Helluva Ride. Meanwhile, Close is preparing for the release of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping—where she plays Drusilla—and is scheduled to receive an honorary Academy Award at the Governors Awards on November 15.

stories.title: Pakistan Demands Action From Afghan Taliban As US Plans Deportations
stories.summary:
Pakistan has called on the Afghan Taliban administration to stop the oppression of women and girls and to prevent militant networks from staging attacks from Afghan territory. Speaking at a UN General Assembly committee, Pakistani counsellor Muhammad Jawad Ajmal stressed that Kabul must fulfill its international duties and address cross-border terrorism that has spiked in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan provinces. Ajmal also criticized the Taliban's denial of basic freedoms to women as contrary to Islamic principles and urged global support for Afghan refugees.

Highlighting regional security challenges, Ajmal pointed to ties between the Afghan Taliban and militant factions, noting that Pakistan launched precise airstrikes on March 16 against Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan infrastructure in Kabul and Nangarhar. He asserted that Islamabad retains the right to self-defense against threats to its security. Meanwhile, the administration of US President Donald Trump has detained dozens of Afghan immigrants in Louisiana and intends to deport them to Afghanistan. According to advocates like Shawn VanDiver of #AfghanEvac, over 150 Afghans face expulsion, with the initial removal flight anticipated as early as Monday.

The impending deportations target individuals who fled after the 2021 US withdrawal and the Taliban's takeover. Many of those facing removal are relatives of individuals who assisted American forces, placing them at severe risk if returned. The US Department of Homeland Security declined to comment on ongoing removal operations due to security protocols. The dual developments highlight ongoing instability and security concerns surrounding individuals displaced by the conflict in Afghanistan.

stories.title: جمہوریہ کانگو میں ایبولا وائرس سے پانچ ہزار سے زائد افراد جاں بحق
stories.summary:
برِ اعظم افریقا کے ملک جمہوریہ کانگو میں ایبولا کی تباہ کن وبا کے نتیجے میں مرنے والوں کی تعداد پانچ ہزار سے تجاوز کر گئی ہے۔ سرکاری اعداد و شمار کے مطابق ملک کے کل 26 میں سے 8 صوبے اس وبا سے شدید متاثر ہوئے ہیں، جبکہ ایبولا کے تصدیق شدہ کیسز کی تعداد 10 ہزار 300 سے بھی زیادہ ہو چکی ہے۔

صحت عامہ کے حکام کے مطابق رواں برس مئی میں شروع ہونے والی یہ وبا اگست کے مہینے میں ملک کی تاریخ کی سب سے زیادہ ہلاکت خیز وبا بن گئی تھی، اور اس وقت اس وبائی مرض میں اموات کی شرح 48.6 فی صد تک پہنچ گئی ہے۔ وزارتِ صحت کی جاری کردہ تازہ ترین رپورٹ میں بتایا گیا ہے کہ اس وبا کا مرکزی مرکز شمال مشرقی صوبہ اِتوری ہے، جہاں موجودہ تنازعات کی صورتحال کی وجہ سے وائرس پر قابو پانے کی کوششوں میں شدید نوعیت کی مشکلات کا سامنا ہے۔

بین الاقوامی اور علاقائی سطح پر اس وائرس کے اثرات دیکھے گئے ہیں، اور کینیا، نائجیریا اور یوگنڈا میں بھی ایبولا کے کیسز کی تصدیق کی جا چکی ہے۔ اقوامِ متحدہ کے مطابق یہ جمہوریہ کانگو کی تاریخ میں ایبولا کی 17 ویں وبا ہے اور مجموعی طور پر تاریخ کی دوسری سب سے بڑی وبا مانی جا رہی ہے۔

عالمی ادارہ صحت کے افریقی دفتر نے زور دیا ہے کہ اس جان لیوا وبا کے مکمل خاتمے کے لیے حفاظتی اقدامات کو فوری طور پر مزید تیز کرنے کی ضرورت ہے۔ اس کے ساتھ ہی متاثرہ علاقوں تک طبی رسائی کو بہتر بنانے اور مقامی آبادی میں اس حوالے سے آگاہی مہم کو وسعت دینے کی سخت ضرورت ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistan Hit by Fresh Price Hike as OGRA Increases LPG Rates
stories.summary:
Consumers across Pakistan faced another financial blow on Saturday as the Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority announced an increase in the price of Liquefied Petroleum Gas. Already dealing with high inflation influenced by the US-Iran conflict scenario, citizens saw the per-kilogram rate of LPG climb by Rs 14.73. This adjustment brings the official government-fixed price for a single kilogram of the fuel to Rs 294.70, according to the regulatory notification released for November.

Alongside the per-kilogram hike, the cost of a standard domestic LPG cylinder rose significantly by Rs 173.86. This increase places the new official rate for a household cylinder at Rs 3,470.90. Despite these established figures, market conditions reflect even steeper costs, with reports indicating that fuel is being sold between Rs 500 and Rs 600 per kilogram in various parts of the country due to artificial price inflation and market manipulation by intermediaries.

Irfan Khokhar, Chairman of the LPG Distributors Association, pointed out that LPG companies and market mafias are exploiting high seasonal demand for illegal profiteering. He highlighted a severe discrepancy between official rates and actual market prices, warning that costs could climb even higher if supply chains experience disruptions. Khokhar emphasized that market stability cannot be achieved unless the government's set rates are strictly implemented across the board.

The latest price surge compounds existing economic pressures on low-income households, arriving on top of regular gas load-shedding. With the rising cost of living and expensive cooking fuel hitting vulnerable populations hardest, industry representatives have called for immediate government intervention to curb black-marketing and hold accountable the individuals driving up consumer costs.

stories.title: Abhishek Sharma Emerges as India's New T20 Cricket Superstar
stories.summary:
Twenty-six-year-old Indian left-handed batsman Abhishek Sharma has transformed into one of the most destructive and consistent players in international T20 cricket. Mentored by former Indian star Yuvraj Singh during the COVID-19 lockdown in Punjab, Abhishek recently reinforced his status by smashing 113 runs off just 38 balls against New Zealand in Wellington. This explosive innings, featuring nine boundaries and eleven sixes, propelled him back to the summit of the global T20 batting rankings and earned praise from opposing players like Daryl Mitchell as well as former cricketers.

Abhishek boasts a striking T20 international record, accumulating 2,267 runs across 71 matches at an average of 33.33, alongside four centuries and an aggressive strike-rate of 196.
